λ 转换演算

The Calculi of Lambda-Conversion

阿隆佐·丘奇

Alonzo Church

第一章　导论

Chapter I. Introductory

1. 函数的概念

1. The Concept of a Function

我们将要建立的形式演算，以数学各分支中出现的函数概念为基础。这个概念有时称为“函数”，有时也使用同义名称“运算”或“变换”。不依赖于函数在任何特定数学领域或其他领域中的具体表现，而研究函数的一般性质，属于形式逻辑，或者处于逻辑与数学的交界处。这种研究是建立这些演算的最初动机；不过，我们将以这样的方式构造它们，使人们可以撇开预期意义，只把它们看作形式系统。

Underlying the formal calculi which we shall develop is the concept of a function, as it appears in various branches of mathematics, either under that name or under one of the synonymous names, “operation” or “transformation.” The study of the general properties of functions, independently of their appearance in any particular mathematical (or other) domain, belongs to formal logic or lies on the boundary line between logic and mathematics. This study is the original motivation for the calculi, but they are so formulated that it is possible to abstract from the intended meaning and regard them merely as formal systems.

函数是一条对应规则：给定某个东西作为自变量，就能得到另一个东西，作为函数对该自变量的值。也就是说，函数是一种运算，可以作用于一个东西，即自变量，而产生另一个东西，即函数值。不过，并不要求这种运算必然能够作用于一切东西。对于每个函数，都有一个可能自变量的类或范围，即这种运算能够有意义地作用于其上的那些东西所构成的类；我们称它为该函数的自变量范围，或独立变量的范围。取遍所有可能自变量所得到的全部函数值构成的类，称为值域，或因变量的范围。

A function is a rule of correspondence by which when anything is given (as argument) another thing (the value of the function for that argument) may be obtained. That is, a function is an operation which may be applied on one thing (the argument) to yield another thing (the value of the function). It is not, however, required that the operation shall necessarily be applicable to everything whatsoever; but for each function there is a class, or range, of possible arguments, the class of things to which the operation is significantly applicable, and this we shall call the range of arguments, or range of the independent variable, for that function. The class of all values of the function, obtained by taking all possible arguments, will be called the range of values, or range of the dependent variable.

如果 f 表示一个特定函数，我们用记法 (fa) 表示函数 f 对自变量 a 的值。如果 a 不属于 f 的自变量范围，记法 (fa) 就没有意义。

If f denotes a particular function, we shall use the notation (fa) for the value of the function f for the argument a. If a does not belong to the range of arguments of f, the notation (fa) shall be meaningless.

当然，函数的自变量范围或值域，可以全部或部分由函数组成。初等微分学中的求导，就是一个熟知的数学例子，它的两个范围都由函数组成。再看积分学，如果在表达式 ∫01(fx)dx 中把函数 f 作为独立变量，就得到一个自变量范围由函数组成、值域由数构成的函数。形式逻辑还提供了其他例子：按照这里的说法，存在量词是一个函数，其自变量范围由命题函数组成，值域由真值组成。

It is, of course, not excluded that the range of arguments or range of values of a function should consist wholly or partly of functions. The derivative, as this notion appears in the elementary differential calculus, is a familiar mathematical example of a function for which both ranges consist of functions. Or, turning to the integral calculus, if in the expression ∫01(fx)dx we take the function f as independent variable, we are led to a function for which the range of arguments consists of functions and the range of values, of numbers. Formal logic provides other examples; thus the existential quantifier, according to the present account, is a function for which the range of arguments consists of propositional functions, and the range of values consists of truth-values.

特别地，并不排除函数 f 本身就是 f 的自变量范围中的一个元素。这种可能性常常受到否认；确实，如果把函数定义为两个预先给定范围之间的对应关系，否认的理由就很清楚。但在这里，我们认为构成函数的运算或对应规则是首先给定的，自变量范围随后才被确定为该运算能够作用于其上的那些东西。这偏离了数学中通常的观点；然而，从考察某个特定领域中的函数，转向考察一般的函数时，这种偏离是自然的，而且下面将证明的一致性定理也支持这种观点。

In particular it is not excluded that one of the elements of the range of arguments of a function f should be the function f itself. This possibility has frequently been denied, and indeed, if a function is defined as a correspondence between two previously given ranges, the reason for the denial is clear. Here, however, we regard the operation or rule of correspondence, which constitutes the function, as being first given, and the range of arguments then determined as consisting of the things to which the operation is applicable. This is a departure from the point of view usual in mathematics, but it is a departure which is natural in passing from consideration of functions in a special domain to the consideration of function in general, and it finds support in consistency theorems which will be proved below.

恒等函数 I 由如下规则定义：无论 x 是什么，(Ix) 都是 x；于是特别地，(II) 是 I。如果函数 H 由如下规则定义：无论 x 是什么，(Hx) 都是 I，那么特别地，(HH) 是 I。如果 Σ 是存在量词，那么 (ΣΣ) 就是真值“真”。

The identity function I is defined by the rule that (Ix) is x, whatever x may be; then in particular (II) is I. If a function H is defined by the rule that (Hx) is I, whatever x may be, then in particular (HH) is I. If Σ is the existential quantifier, then (ΣΣ) is the truth-value truth.

函数 I 和 H 也可以作为这样的例子：它们的自变量范围由一切东西组成。

The functions I and H may also be cited as examples of functions for which the range of arguments consists of all things whatsoever.

2. 外延与内涵

2. Extension and Intension

前面的讨论没有确定，在什么情况下应当把两个函数看作相同的。

The foregoing discussion leaves it undetermined under what circumstances two functions shall be considered the same.

最直接的、从某些观点看来也是最好的处理办法，是规定：两个函数 f 和 g 相同，当且仅当它们具有相同的自变量范围，而且对于属于该范围的每个元素 a，(fa) 与 (ga) 相同。采用这种做法时，我们说所讨论的是外延意义上的函数。

The most immediate and, from some points of view, the best way to settle this question is to specify that two functions f and g are the same if they have the same range of arguments and, for every element a that belongs to this range, (fa) is the same as (ga). When this is done we shall say that we are dealing with functions in extension.

不过，也可以允许两个函数因其对应规则的意义不同而有所区别，即使把这两条规则作用于任何一个特定自变量，总会得到相同结果。采用这种做法时，我们说所讨论的是内涵意义上的函数。两条对应规则“意义不同”的概念是模糊的，但借助某种记法系统，可以用多种方式使它精确。我们不试图判定什么才是意义不同的真正概念；只要所采用的同一性标准比外延函数的标准更严格，就称其为内涵函数。因此，内涵函数的概念并非只有一个，而是有许多个，涉及不同程度的内涵性。

It is possible, however, to allow two functions to be different on the ground that the rule of correspondence is different in meaning in the two cases although always yielding the same result when applied to any particular argument. When this is done we shall say that we are dealing with functions in intension. The notion of difference in meaning between two rules of correspondence is a vague one, but, in terms of some system of notation, it can be made exact in various ways. We shall not attempt to decide what is the true notion of difference in meaning but shall speak of functions in intension in any case where a more severe criterion of identity is adopted than for functions in extension. There is thus not one notion of function in intension, but many notions, involving various degrees of intensionality.

在下面建立的 λ 转换演算和受限 λ-K 转换演算中，如果愿意，可以把演算的表达式解释为表示外延函数。但在 λ-δ 转换演算中，函数同一性的概念通过符号 δ 被引入系统。为了保持变换规则的有限性，必须以某种方式表述这些规则，从而使外延函数的解释不再可能。λ-δ 转换演算中的表达式，可以解释为表示适当类型的内涵函数。

In the calculus of λ-conversion and the calculus of restricted λ-K-conversion, as developed below, it is possible, if desired, to interpret the expressions of the calculus as denoting functions in extension. However, in the calculus of λ-δ-conversion, where the notion of identity of functions is introduced into the system by the symbol δ, it is necessary, in order to preserve the finitary character of the transformation rules, so to formulate these rules that an interpretation by functions in extension becomes impossible. The expressions which appear in the calculus of λ-δ-conversion are interpretable as denoting functions in intension of an appropriate kind.

3. 多变量函数

3. Functions of Several Variables

到目前为止，我们一直默默地把“函数”限制为单变量函数，或单自变量函数。但对于每个正整数 n，我们都希望有 n 变量函数的概念。而且，为了避免对每个 n 都引入一个独立的原始概念，我们希望找到一种办法，把 n 变量函数解释为单变量函数的特例。就目前的目的而言，最方便、最自然的办法，是采用 Schönfinkel [49] 的一个思想：把二变量函数看作其值为单变量函数的单变量函数，把三变量函数看作其值为二变量函数的单变量函数，依此类推。

So far we have tacitly restricted the term “function” to functions of one variable (or, of one argument). It is desirable, however, for each positive integer n, to have the notion of a function of n variables. And, in order to avoid the introduction of a separate primitive idea for each n, it is desirable to find a means of explaining functions of n variables as particular cases of functions of one variable. For our present purpose, the most convenient and natural method of doing this is to adopt an idea of Schönfinkel [49], according to which a function of two variables is regarded as a function of one variable whose values are functions of one variable, a function of three variables as a function of one variable whose values are functions of two variables, and so on.

因此，如果 f 表示一个特定的二变量函数，记法 ((fa)b)，我们常把它缩写为 (fab) 或 fab，表示 f 对自变量 a、b 的值。记法 (fa)，我们常把它缩写为 fa，表示一个单变量函数，它对任意自变量 x 的值是 fax。函数 f 有一个自变量范围，只有当 a 属于该范围时，记法 fa 才有意义；函数 fa 又有自己的自变量范围，一般说来，这个范围随 a 的不同而不同，只有当 b 属于 fa 的自变量范围时，记法 fab 才有意义。

Thus if f denotes a particular function of two variables, the notation ((fa)b), which we shall frequently abbreviate as (fab) or fab, represents the value of f for the arguments a,b. The notation (fa), which we shall frequently abbreviate as fa, represents a function of one variable, whose value for any argument x is fax. The function f has a range of arguments, and the notation fa is meaningful only when a belongs to that range; the function fa again has a range of arguments, which is, in general, different for different elements a, and the notation fab is meaningful only when b belongs to the range of arguments of fa.

类似地，如果 f 表示一个三变量函数，(((fa)b)c) 或 fabc 表示 f 对自变量 a、b、c 的值；fa 表示某个二变量函数，而 ((fa)b) 或 fab 表示某个单变量函数，依此类推。

Similarly, if f denotes a function of three variables, (((fa)b)c) or fabc denotes the value of f for the arguments a,b,c, fa denoting a certain function of two variables, and ((fa)b) or fab denoting a certain function of one variable, and so on.

按照另一种在某些场合更好的方案，二变量函数被看作自变量为有序对的单变量函数，三变量函数被看作自变量为有序三元组的函数，依此类推。不过，这里并没有排除这种多变量函数概念。因为下面将看到，有序对、有序三元组等概念，可以借助抽象，即第 4 节，以及 Schönfinkel 的多变量函数概念来定义；因此，另一种意义上的多变量函数也得到了处理。

According to another scheme, which is the better one for certain purposes, a function of two variables is regarded as a function (of one variable) whose arguments are ordered pairs, a function of three variables as a function whose arguments are ordered triads, and so on. This other concept of a function of several variables is not, however, excluded here. For, as will appear below, the notions of ordered pair, ordered triad, etc., are definable by means of abstraction (§4) and the Schönfinkel concept of a function of several variables; and thus functions of several variables in the other sense are also provided for.

Schönfinkel 意义下的二变量函数的一个例子，是常值函数 K，定义规则是：无论 x 和 y 是什么，Kxy 都是 x。例如，KII 是 I，KHI 是 H，等等。而且 KI 是 H，其中 H 是上面第 1 节定义的函数。类似地，KK 是一个值恒等于 K 的函数。

An example of a function of two variables (in the sense of Schönfinkel) is the constancy function K, defined by the rule that Kxy is x, whatever x and y may be. We have, for instance, that KII is I, KHI is H, and so on. Also KI is H (where H is the function defined above in §1). Similarly KK is a function whose value is constant and equal to K.

另一个二变量函数的例子，是对自变量 f、x 的值为 (fx) 的函数；由于稍后将说明的理由，我们用符号 1 表示它。把函数 1 看作单变量函数时，它是一种恒等函数，因为只要记法 (1f) 有意义，它就表示与 f 相同的函数。不过，函数 I 与 1 并不相同，因为前者的自变量范围包含一切东西，而后者只包含所有函数。

Another example of a function of two variables is the function whose value for the arguments f,x is (fx); for reasons which will appear later we designate this function by the symbol 1. The function 1, regarded as a function of one variable, is a kind of identity function, since the notation (1f), whenever significant, denotes the same function as f; the functions I and 1 are not, however, the same function, since the range of arguments consists in one case of all things whatever, in the other case merely of all functions.

二变量或更多变量函数的其他例子，包括已经定义的 H，以及函数 T、J、B、C、W、S。它们分别由以下规则定义：Txf 是 (fx)，Jfxyz 是 fx(fzy)，Bfgx 是 f(gx)，Cfxy 是 (fyx)，Wfx 是 (fxx)，Snfx 是 f(nfx)。

Other examples of functions of two or more variables are the function H, already defined, and the functions T,J,B,C,W,S, defined respectively by the rules that Txf is (fx), Jfxyz is fx(fzy), Bfgx is f(gx), Cfxy is (fyx), Wfx is (fxx), Snfx is f(nfx).

其中，B 和 C 对读者来说，可能以别的名称更为熟悉：B 是两个变换 f 和 g 的积或合成，C 是二变量函数 f 的逆序函数。说 BII 是 I，就是说，无论在哪个领域内考虑变换，恒等变换与恒等变换的积都是恒等变换；说 B11 是 1，就是说，在任何完全由函数组成的领域内，恒等变换与自身的积都是恒等变换。BI 是 1，因为它是与恒等变换作合成的运算，因此是一种恒等运算，但只适用于变换。

Of these, B and C may be more familiar to the reader under other names, as the product or resultant of two transformations f and g, and as the converse of a function of two variables f. To say that BII is I is to say that the product of the identity transformation by the identity transformation is the identity transformation, whatever the domain within which transformations are being considered; to say that B11 is 1 is to say that within any domain consisting entirely of functions the product of the identity transformation by itself is the identity transformation. BI is 1, since it is the operation of composition with the identity transformation, and thus an identity operation, but one applicable only to transformations.

读者还可以验证：CK 是 H，CT 是 1，C1 是 T，CI 是 T。1 与 I 具有相同逆序函数，原因是：虽然它们不是同一个函数，但在所有能够有意义地作用于两个自变量的情况下，它们的效果相同。函数 BCC，即逆序的逆序，在作用于二变量函数时具有恒等的效果；但作用于单变量函数时，其效果是限制自变量范围，使该函数在可能时变成二变量函数。因此，BCCI 是 1。

The reader may further verify that CK is H, CT is 1, C1 is T, CI is T. That 1 and I have the same converse is explained by the fact that, while not the same function, they have the same effect in all cases where they can significantly be applied to two arguments. The function BCC, the converse of the converse, has the effect of an identity when applied to a function of two variables, but when applied to a function of one variable it has the effect of so restricting the range of arguments as to transform the function into a function of two variables (if possible); thus BCCI is 1.

这些函数之间还有许多类似关系，其中有些相当复杂。

There are many similar relations between these functions, some of them quite complicated.

4. 抽象

4. Abstraction

就目前的目的而言，必须仔细区分两类表达式：一类是表示函数的符号或表达式；另一类含有变量，不确定地表示函数的某个值。这种区别在通常的数学函数论语言中，多少有些模糊。

For our present purpose it is necessary to distinguish carefully between a symbol or expression which denotes a function and an expression which contains a variable and denotes ambiguously some value of the function, a distinction which is more or less obscured in the usual language of mathematical function theory.

以自然数函数论为例，考虑表达式 (x2+x)2。如果我们说“(x2+x)2 大于 1,000”，就是在作出一个依赖于 x 的陈述；除非把 x 确定为某个特定自然数，否则这个陈述实际上没有意义。另一方面，如果我们说“(x2+x)2 是原始递归函数”，就是在作出一个确定的陈述，其意义完全不依赖于变量 x 的取值；因此，在这种情况下，x 起着表观变量或约束变量的作用。两种情况的区别是：第一种情况下，表达式 (x2+x)2 是自然数的不确定的、或可变的名称；第二种情况下，它是一个特定函数的名称。今后，我们将用 (x2+x)2 表示自然数的不确定名称，而用 (λx(x2+x)2) 表示相应的函数；其他情况也同样区分。

To take an example from the theory of functions of natural numbers, consider the expression (x2+x)2. If we say, “(x2+x)2 is greater than 1,000,” we make a statement which depends on x and actually has no meaning unless x is determined as some particular natural number. On the other hand, if we say, “(x2+x)2 is a primitive recursive function,” we make a definite statement whose meaning in no way depends on a determination of the variable x (so that in this case x plays the rôle of an apparent, or bound, variable). The difference between the two cases is that in the first case the expression (x2+x)2 serves as an ambiguous, or variable, denotation of a natural number, while in the second case it serves as the denotation of a particular function. We shall hereafter distinguish by using (x2+x)2 when we intend an ambiguous denotation of a natural number, but (λx(x2+x)2) as the denotation of the corresponding function, and likewise in other cases.

当然，记法 (x2+x)2 通常也用于某个实数函数、某个复数函数等等，这一点与当前问题无关。在逻辑上精确的记法中，自然数加法、实数加法、复数加法将用不同符号表示，例如 +n、+r、+c；自然数平方、实数平方、复数平方这三个函数，也将作类似区分。这样，记法 (x2+x)2 的确切意义的不确定性，以及由此造成的函数 (λx(x2+x)2) 的自变量范围的不确定性，就会消失。

It is, of course, irrelevant here that the notation (x2+x)2 is commonly used also for a certain function of real numbers, a certain function of complex numbers, etc. In a logically exact notation the functions, addition of natural numbers, addition of real numbers, addition of complex numbers, would be denoted by different symbols, say +n, +r, +c; and the three functions, square of a natural number, square of a real number, square of a complex number, would be similarly distinguished. The uncertainty as to the exact meaning of the notation (x2+x)2, and the consequent uncertainty as to the range of arguments of the function (λx(x2+x)2), would then disappear.

一般说来，如果 M 是一个含有自由变量 x 的表达式，即 M 的意义依赖于 x 的确定，那么 (λxM) 表示一个函数；对于自变量 a，它的值由把 M 中的 x 替换为表示 a 的符号后所得的结果来表示。函数 (λxM) 的自变量范围，由所有这样的对象 a 组成：把表示 a 的符号代入 M 中的 x 后，表达式 M 有意义。

In general, if M is an expression containing a variable x (as a free variable, i.e., in such a way that the meaning of M depends on a determination of x), then (λxM) denotes a function whose value, for an argument a, is denoted by the result of substituting (a symbol denoting) a for x in M. The range of arguments of the function (λxM) consists of all objects a such that the expression M has a meaning when (a symbol denoting) a is substituted for x.

如果 M 不含自由变量 x，那么 (λxM) 可以用来表示一个值恒等于 M 所表示对象的函数，而且它的自变量范围包含一切东西。下面讨论 λ-K 转换演算时，将允许这种用法；但由于稍后将说明的技术原因，在 λ 转换演算和 λ-δ 转换演算中，这种用法被排除。

If M does not contain the variable x (as a free variable), then (λxM) might be used to denote a function whose value is constant and equal to (the thing denoted by) M, and whose range of arguments consists of all things. This usage is contemplated below in connection with the calculi of λ-K-conversion, but is excluded from the calculi of λ-conversion and λ-δ-conversion, for technical reasons which will appear.

注意，虽然 x 在 M 中作为自由变量出现，但在表达式 (λxM) 中，x 却是约束变量或表观变量。例如，方程 (x2+x)2=(y2+y)2 表达了 x 和 y 所表示的自然数之间的一种关系，它的真假依赖于 x 和 y 的确定；事实上，当且仅当 x 和 y 被确定为表示同一个自然数时，它为真。但方程 (λx(x2+x)2)=(λy(y2+y)2) 表达的是一个特定命题，即两边表示同一个函数，而且这个命题为真；这里不存在确定 x 和 y 取值的问题。

Notice that, although x occur as a free variable in M, nevertheless, in the expression (λxM), x is a bound, or apparent, variable. Example: the equation (x2+x)2=(y2+y)2 expresses a relation between the natural numbers denoted by x and y and its truth depends on a determination of x and of y (in fact, it is true if and only if x and y are determined as denoting the same natural number); but the equation (λx(x2+x)2)=(λy(y2+y)2) expresses a particular proposition, namely that (λx(x2+x)2) is the same function as (λy(y2+y)2), and it is true (there is no question of a determination of x and y).

还要注意，λ 或 λx 不是任何函数或其他抽象对象的名称，而是一个不完全符号；也就是说，这个符号单独没有意义，但适当构成的、含有该符号的表达式有意义。我们称符号 λx 为抽象算子，并说 (λxM) 所表示的函数，是从表达式 M 通过抽象得到的。

Notice also that λ, or λx, is not the name of any function or other abstract object, but is an incomplete symbol, i.e., the symbol has no meaning alone, but appropriately formed expressions containing the symbol have a meaning. We call the symbol λx an abstraction operator, and speak of the function which is denoted by (λxM) as obtained from the expression M by abstraction.

表达式 (λx(λyM))，我们常缩写为 (λxy.M)，表示一个函数：对于由 x 表示的自变量，它的值由 (λyM) 表示。因此，它是一个值为函数的函数，或二变量函数。表达式 (λy(λxM))，缩写为 (λyx.M)，表示 (λxy.M) 所表示函数的逆序函数。类似地，(λx(λy(λzM)))，缩写为 (λxyz.M)，表示三变量函数，依此类推。

The expression (λx(λyM)), which we shall often abbreviate as (λxy.M), denotes a function whose value, for an argument denoted by x, is denoted by (λyM), thus a function whose values are functions, or a function of two variables. The expression (λy(λxM)), abbreviated as (λyx.M), denotes the converse function to that denoted by (λxy.M). Similarly (λx(λy(λzM))), abbreviated as (λxyz.M), denotes a function of three variables, and so on.

前面各节作为例子引入的函数，现在都可以在需要时用抽象算子表示。例如，I 是 (λxx)；J 是 (λfxyz.fx(fzy))；S 是 (λnfx.f(nfx))；H 是 (λxI)，或 (λx(λyy))，或 (λxy.y)；K 是 (λxy.x)；1 是 (λfx.fx)。

Functions introduced in previous sections as examples can now be expressed, if desired, by means of abstraction operators. For instance, I is (λxx); J is (λfxyz.fx(fzy)); S is (λnfx.f(nfx)); H is (λxI), or (λx(λyy)), or (λxy.y); K is (λxy.x); 1 is (λfx.fx).

第二章　λ 转换

Chapter II. Lambda-Conversion

5. 原始符号与公式

5. Primitive Symbols, and Formulas

现在开始建立一个形式系统，我们称它为 λ 转换演算。第一章所描述的函数观念体系，将是它的一种可能解释或应用。

We turn now to the development of a formal system, which we shall call the calculus of λ-conversion, and which shall have as a possible interpretation or application the system of ideas about functions described in Chapter I.

这个演算的原始符号包括三个符号 λ、(、)，我们称它们为非适当符号；以及一个无穷符号表：

The primitive symbols of this calculus are three symbols, λ, (, ), which we shall call improper symbols, and an infinite list of symbols:

a,b,c,…,x,y,z,a¯,b¯,…,z¯,a¯¯,…

我们称后者为变量。变量在这个最初给定的无穷表中的排列顺序，称为它们的字母顺序。

These we shall call variables. The order in which the variables appear in this originally given infinite list shall be called their alphabetical order.

公式是原始符号的任意有限序列。按照下面的规则 1–4，某些公式被区分为合式公式，而变量在合式公式中的每次出现，被区分为自由出现或约束出现。这些规则构成了对上述术语的递归定义：

A formula is any finite sequence of primitive symbols. Certain formulas are distinguished as well-formed formulas, and each occurrence of a variable in a well-formed formula is distinguished as free or bound, in accordance with the following rules (1–4), which constitute a definition of these terms by recursion:

1. 变量 x 是合式公式，而且变量 x 在这个公式中的出现是自由出现。

1. A variable x is a well-formed formula, and the occurrence of the variable x in this formula is free.

2. 如果 F 和 A 合式，那么 (FA) 合式；变量 y 在 F 中的某次出现，在 (FA) 中是自由还是约束，取决于它在 F 中是自由还是约束；变量 y 在 A 中的某次出现，在 (FA) 中是自由还是约束，也取决于它在 A 中是自由还是约束。

2. If F and A are well-formed, (FA) is well-formed, and an occurrence of a variable y in F is free or bound in (FA) according as it is free or bound in F, and an occurrence of a variable y in A is free or bound in (FA) according as it is free or bound in A.

3. 如果 M 合式，而且至少含有一次 x 的自由出现，那么 (λxM) 合式；异于 x 的变量 y 在 (λxM) 中的某次出现，是自由还是约束，取决于它在 M 中是自由还是约束。x 在 (λxM) 中的所有出现都是约束出现。

3. If M is well-formed and contains at least one free occurrence of x, then (λxM) is well-formed, and an occurrence of a variable y, other than x, in (λxM) is free or bound in (λxM) according as it is free or bound in M. All occurrences of x in (λxM) are bound.

4. 一个公式是合式的，以及其中某次变量出现是自由的或约束的，只有在这能由规则 1–3 推出时才成立。

4. A formula is well-formed, and an occurrence of a variable in it is free, or is bound, only when this follows from 1–3.

公式的自由变量，是在公式中至少有一次自由出现的变量。公式的约束变量，是在公式中至少有一次约束出现的变量。

The free variables of a formula are the variables which have at least one free occurrence in the formula. The bound variables of a formula are the variables which have at least one bound occurrence in the formula.

今后，正如刚才陈述规则 1–4 时所做的那样，我们将用粗体大写字母代表可变的或尚未确定的公式，用粗体小写字母代表可变的或尚未确定的变量。除非某个具体场合另有说明，应当理解，粗体大写字母所代表的公式是合式公式。因此，粗体字母不是我们正在建立的演算的一部分，而是谈论该演算时使用的工具：它们不属于系统本身，而属于系统的元数学或语法。

Hereafter (as was just done in the statement of the rules 1–4) we shall use bold capital letters to stand for variable or undetermined formulas, and bold small letters to stand for variable or undetermined variables. Unless otherwise indicated in a particular case, it is to be understood that formulas represented by bold capital letters are well-formed formulas. Bold letters are thus not part of the calculus which we are developing but are a device for use in talking about the calculus: they belong, not to the system itself, but to the metamathematics or syntax of the system.

我们还将使用另一种语法记法：

Another syntactical notation which we shall use is the notation:

SNxM|

它表示把 M 中所有 x 都替换为 N 后得到的公式。除非 x 是 M 的约束变量，而且 N 不是单独一个变量，否则这个公式是合式的，见第 7 节。特别地，如果 x 不在 M 中出现，所得公式就是 M 本身。

This shall stand for the formula which results by substitution of N for x throughout M. This formula is well-formed, except in the case that x is a bound variable of M and N is other than a single variable; see §7. In the special case that x does not occur in M, it is the same formula as M.

为了在处理具体合式公式时做到简短而清楚，我们常常不把公式完整写出，而使用各种缩写。

For brevity and perspicuity in dealing with particular well-formed formulas, we often do not write them in full but employ various abbreviations.

一种缩写方法是名称定义：引入一个特定的新符号，来代替或代表一个特定的合式公式。我们用一个箭头表示这种名称定义，箭头从正在引入的新符号指向它所替代的合式公式；这个箭头可读作“代表”。例如，我们立即作如下名称定义：

One method of abbreviation is by means of a nominal definition, which introduces a particular new symbol to replace or stand for a particular well-formed formula. We indicate such a nominal definition by an arrow, pointing from the new symbol which is being introduced to the well-formed formula which it is to replace (the arrow may be read “stands for”). As an example we make at once the nominal definition:

I→(λaa).

这意味着，I 将用作 (λaa) 的缩写；因此，(II) 是 ((λaa)(λaa)) 的缩写，(λa(aI)) 是 (λa(a(λaa))) 的缩写，等等。

This means that I will be used as an abbreviation for (λaa), and consequently that (II) will be used as an abbreviation for ((λaa)(λaa)), (λa(aI)) as an abbreviation for (λa(a(λaa))), etc.

另一种缩写方法是模式定义：引入一类具有某种形式的新表达式，并规定一个模式，使每个新表达式都代表一个相应的合式公式。模式定义也用箭头表示，但箭头两边的表达式含有粗体字母。当一个或多个粗体小写字母出现在箭头后的表达式，即定义项中，而不出现在箭头前的表达式，即被定义项中时，应当采用如下约定：

Another method of abbreviation is by means of a schematic definition, which introduces a class of new expressions of a certain form, specifying a scheme according to which each of the new expressions stands for a corresponding well-formed formula. Such a schematic definition is indicated in a similar fashion by an arrow, but the expressions on each side of the arrow contain bold letters. When a bold small letter, one or several, occurs in the expression following the arrow (the definiens) but not in the expression preceding the arrow (the definiendum), the following convention is to be understood:

粗体 a 代表按字母顺序第一个没有在定义项其他位置出现的变量，粗体 b 代表按字母顺序第二个这样的变量，粗体 c 代表第三个，依此类推。

Bold a stands for the first variable in alphabetical order not otherwise appearing in the definiens, bold b stands for the second such variable in alphabetical order, bold c the third, and so on.

例如，我们立即作如下模式定义：

As examples, we make at once the following schematic definitions:

[M+N]→(λa(λb((Ma)((Na)b)))).[M·N]→(λa(M(Na))).[MN]→(NM).

第一个定义意味着，例如，[x+y] 是 (λa(λb((xa)((ya)b)))) 的缩写，[a+c] 是 (λb(λd((ab)((cb)d)))) 的缩写，而 [I+I] 是 (λb(λc((Ib)((Ib)c)))) 的缩写，等等。

The first of these definitions means that, for instance, [x+y] will be used as an abbreviation for (λa(λb((xa)((ya)b)))), and [a+c] will be used as an abbreviation for (λb(λd((ab)((cb)d)))), and [I+I] as an abbreviation for (λb(λc((Ib)((Ib)c)))), etc.

作为另一种缩写手段，只要不产生歧义，我们就允许省略 (FA) 中的圆括号，不论 (FA) 是正在书写的整个公式，还是其中的一部分。恢复省略的圆括号时，约定按左结合处理，参见 Schönfinkel [49]、Curry [17]。例如，fxy 是 ((fx)y) 的缩写，f(xy) 是 (f(xy)) 的缩写，fxyz 是 (((fx)y)z) 的缩写，f(xy)z 是 ((f(xy))z) 的缩写，f(λxx)y 是 ((f(λxx))y) 的缩写，等等。

As a further device of abbreviation, we shall allow the omission of the parentheses in (FA) when this may be done without ambiguity, whether (FA) is the entire formula being written or merely some part of it. In restoring such omitted parentheses, the convention is to be followed that association is to the left (cf. Schönfinkel [49], Curry [17]). For example, fxy is an abbreviation of ((fx)y), f(xy) is an abbreviation of (f(xy)), fxyz is an abbreviation of (((fx)y)z), f(xy)z is an abbreviation of ((f(xy))z), f(λxx)y is an abbreviation of ((f(λxx))y), etc.

对于因模式定义而含有方括号的表达式，我们允许类似地省略方括号，并同样约定左结合。因此，x+y+z 是 [[x+y]+z] 的缩写，而这个表达式又按照前面引入的模式定义，缩写某个合式公式。此外，我们还允许省略一对方括号，同时在原左方括号的位置放一个点。此时不采用左结合约定，而是规定：在保持公式合式的前提下，这个被省略的括号从粗点起尽可能向右延伸。例如，x+.y+z 是 [x+[y+z]] 的缩写，x+.y+.z+t 是 [x+[y+[z+t]]] 的缩写，(λx.x+x) 是 (λx[x+x]) 的缩写。

In expressions which (in consequence of schematic definitions) contain brackets, we allow a similar omission of brackets, subject to a similar convention of association to the left; thus x+y+z is an abbreviation for [[x+y]+z], which expression is in turn an abbreviation for a certain well-formed formula in accordance with the schematic definition already introduced. Moreover we allow, as an abbreviation, omitting a pair of brackets and at the same time putting a dot or period in the place of the initial bracket; in this case the convention, instead of association to the left, is that the omitted bracket extends from the bold period as far to the right as possible, consistently with the formula’s being well-formed, so that, for instance, x+.y+z is an abbreviation for [x+[y+z]], and x+.y+.z+t is an abbreviation for [x+[y+[z+t]]], and (λx.x+x) is an abbreviation for (λx[x+x]).

我们还引入如下模式定义：

We also introduce the following schematic definitions:

(λx.FA)→(λx(FA)),(λxy.FA)→(λx(λy(FA))),(λxyz.FA)→(λx(λy(λz(FA)))),

对于任意多个互不相同的变量 x、y、z、……，依此类推。我们还允许在粗点前以类似方式省略 λ，其中粗点按上一段的方法表示省略的方括号。例如，λxyz.x+y+z 是 (λx(λy(λz[[x+y]+z]))) 的缩写。

And so on for any number of variables x,y,z,…, which must be all different. And we allow similar omissions of λ’s, preceding a bold period which represents an omitted bracket in the way described in the preceding paragraph, using, e.g., λxyz.x+y+z as an abbreviation for (λx(λy(λz[[x+y]+z]))).

最后，当 (λxM)、(λx.FA)、(λxy.FA)、(λxyz.FA) 等表达式是正在书写的整个公式时，我们允许省略最外层圆括号；但当其中某个表达式作为公式的真部分出现时，不允许这样做。

Finally, we allow omission of the outside parentheses in (λxM), or in (λx.FA), or (λxy.FA), or (λxyz.FA), etc., when this is the entire formula being written, but not when one of these expressions appears as a proper part of a formula.

今后，书写定义时，我们将按照此前引入的缩写和定义来缩写定义项。因此，[M+N] 的定义现在写成：

Hereafter, in writing definitions, we shall abbreviate the definiens in accordance with previously introduced abbreviations and definitions. Thus the definition of [M+N] would now be written:

[M+N]→λab.Ma(Nab).

定义和其他缩写的引入，只是为了方便；严格说来，它们根本不是形式系统的一部分。谈到公式的自由变量、约束变量、长度，即符号个数、一个公式作为另一个公式的一部分的出现等时，所指的始终是有关公式的未缩写形式。

Definitions and other abbreviations are introduced merely as matters of convenience and are not properly part of the formal system at all. When we speak of the free variables of a formula, the bound variables of a formula, the length (number of symbols) of a formula, the occurrences of one formula as a part of another, etc., the reference is always to the unabbreviated form of the formulas in question.

当然，引入和使用定义及其他缩写时，必须遵守一个限制：给定的缩写形式究竟代表哪个公式，绝不能有歧义。实际使用中，还希望有某些进一步限制，例如，定义项的所有自由变量都应当在被定义项中明确表示。就目前的目的而言，无须精确表述这些限制，因为如前所述，所有定义和缩写都在形式系统之外，原则上都可以不用。

The introduction and use of definitions and other abbreviations is, of course, subject to the restriction that there shall never be any ambiguity as to what formula a given abbreviated form stands for. In practice certain further restrictions are also desirable, e.g., that all free variables of the definiens be represented explicitly in the definiendum. Exact formulation of these restrictions is unnecessary for our present purpose, since all definitions and abbreviations are extraneous to the formal system, as just explained, and in principle dispensable.

6. 转换

6. Conversion

现在，我们在合式公式上引入以下三种运算，或变换规则：

We introduce now the three following operations, or transformation rules, on well-formed formulas:

I. 把公式的任意部分 M 替换为 SyxM|，条件是 x 不是 M 的自由变量，而且 y 不在 M 中出现。

I. To replace any part M of a formula by SyxM|, provided that x is not a free variable of M and y does not occur in M.

II. 把公式的任意部分 ((λxM)N) 替换为 SNxM|，条件是 M 的约束变量既不同于 x，也不同于 N 的自由变量。

II. To replace any part ((λxM)N) of a formula by SNxM|, provided that the bound variables of M are distinct both from x and from the free variables of N.

III. 把公式的任意部分 SNxM| 替换为 ((λxM)N)，条件是 ((λxM)N) 合式，而且 M 的约束变量既不同于 x，也不同于 N 的自由变量。

III. To replace any part SNxM| of a formula by ((λxM)N), provided that ((λxM)N) is well-formed and the bound variables of M are distinct both from x and from the free variables of N.

在这些规则的陈述中，以及今后通常的用法中，应当理解，公式的“部分”是指连续的合式部分，而且不能紧接在符号 λ 的某次出现之后。

In the statement of these rules, and hereafter generally, it is to be understood that the word part (of a formula) means consecutive well-formed part not immediately following an occurrence of the symbol λ.

同一个公式作为另一个公式的这种部分出现多次时，每次出现都算作不同的部分。例如，规则 I 可以把 ab(λaa)(λaa) 变成 ab(λbb)(λaa)。规则 III 可以把 λaa 变成 λa.(λaa)a。但规则 III 不能把 (λaa) 变成 (λ((λaa)a)a)；事实上，后一个公式甚至不是合式的。

When the same formula occurs several times as such a part of another formula, each occurrence is to be counted as a different part. Thus, for instance, Rule I may be used to transform ab(λaa)(λaa) into ab(λbb)(λaa). Rule III may be used to transform λaa into λa.(λaa)a. But Rule III may not be used to transform (λaa) into (λ((λaa)a)a); the latter formula is, in fact, not even well-formed.

规则 I–III 有一个重要性质：它们是有效的，或“确定的”。也就是说，对于任意两个公式 A 和 B，总有办法判定 A 是否能通过应用其中一条规则变成 B；如果能，还可以判定是哪一条规则。

Rules I–III have the important property that they are effective or “definite,” i.e., there is a means of always determining of any two formulas A and B whether A can be transformed into B by an application of one of the rules (and, if so, of which one).

如果 A 能通过应用规则 I–III 中的一条变成 B，我们就说 A 可直接转换为 B，缩写为“A imc B”。如果存在一个有限公式序列，以 A 为首项，以 B 为末项，而且除末项外，每个公式都可直接转换为下一个公式，就说 A 可转换为 B，缩写为“A conv B”。通过某个特定的有限次规则 I–III 的应用，从 A 得到 B 的过程，称为 A 到 B 的一次转换。这里的 conversion 与形成逆序函数的 converse 无关；相应名词使用 convert，而不是 converse。A 到 B 的转换中，规则 I–III 的应用次数也可以为零，此时 B 就是与 A 相同的公式。

If A can be transformed into B by an application of one of the Rules I–III, we shall say that A is immediately convertible into B (abbreviation, “A imc B”). If there is a finite sequence of formulas, in which A is the first formula and B the last, and in which each formula except the last is immediately convertible into the next one, we shall say that A is convertible into B (abbreviation, “A conv B”); and the process of obtaining B from A by a particular finite sequence of applications of Rules I–III will be called a conversion of A into B (no reference is intended to conversion in the sense of forming the converse; for the corresponding noun we use, not “converse,” but “convert”). It is not excluded that the number of applications of Rules I–III in a conversion of A into B should be zero, B being then the same formula as A.

当 A conv B 时，A 与 B 之间的关系称为相互可转换；“A 与 B 相互可转换”与“A conv B”同义。相互可转换关系是传递的、对称的、自反的；它之所以对称，是因为规则 II 与 III 互为逆运算，而规则 I 是自身的逆运算。

The relation which holds between A and B when A conv B will be called interconvertibility, and we shall use the expression “A and B are interconvertible” as synonymous with “A conv B.” The relation of interconvertibility is transitive, symmetric, and reflexive; symmetric because Rules II and III are inverses of each other and Rule I is its own inverse.

如果存在 A 到 B 的转换，其中没有应用规则 II 或规则 III，就说 A 可经 I 转换为 B，记为“A conv-I B”。类似地定义“A conv-I-II B”和“A conv-I-III B”。

If there is a conversion of A into B which contains no application of Rule II or Rule III, we shall say that A is convertible-I into B (A conv-I B). Similarly we define “A conv-I-II B” and “A conv-I-III B.”

不含规则 II 的应用、而恰好含有一次规则 III 的应用的转换，称为一次展开。不含规则 III 的应用、而恰好含有一次规则 II 的应用的转换，称为一次归约。如果存在 A 到 B 的归约，就说 A 可直接归约为 B，记为“A imr B”。如果存在 A 到 B 的转换，由一次或多次连续归约组成，就说 A 可归约为 B，记为“A red B”。因此，“A red B”与“A conv-I-II B”的意义，唯一的区别在于前者要求 A 到 B 的转换中至少应用一次规则 II。

A conversion which contains no application of Rule II and exactly one application of Rule III will be called an expansion. A conversion which contains no application of Rule III and exactly one application of Rule II will be called a reduction. If there is a reduction of A into B, we shall say that A is immediately reducible to B (A imr B). If there is a conversion of A into B which consists of one or more successive reductions, we shall say that A is reducible to B (A red B). The meaning of “A red B” thus differs from that of “A conv-I-II B” only in that the former implies the presence of at least one application of Rule II in the conversion of A into B.

对一个公式应用规则 II，称为对所影响部分 ((λxM)N) 的一次收缩。

An application of Rule II to a formula will be called a contraction of the part ((λxM)N) which is affected.

如果一个合式公式不含形如 ((λxM)N) 的部分，就说它处于正规形。如果 B 处于正规形，而且 A conv B，就称 B 为 A 的一个正规形。如果存在一个公式 B 是 A 的正规形，就说 A 有正规形。

A well-formed formula will be said to be in normal form if it contains no part of the form ((λxM)N). We shall call B a normal form of A if B is in normal form and A conv B. We shall say that A has a normal form if there is a formula B which is a normal form of A.

如果一个合式公式处于正规形，没有变量同时作为它的约束变量和自由变量出现，而且按组成公式的符号从左到右的顺序，首先出现的约束变量是按字母顺序第一个不是该公式自由变量的变量，并且紧接在 λ 后出现的各变量，按其在公式中的出现顺序，恰好按字母顺序排列，没有重复，除公式的自由变量外也没有遗漏，就说该公式处于主正规形。例如，λab.ba、λa.a(λc.bc)、λb.ba 处于主正规形；λac.ca、λbc.cb、λa.a(λa.ba) 处于正规形，但不处于主正规形。

A well-formed formula will be said to be in principal normal form if it is in normal form, and no variable is both a bound variable and free variable of it, and the first bound variable occurring in it (in the left-to-right order of the symbols which compose the formula) is the same as the first variable in alphabetical order which is not a free variable of it, and the variables which occur in it immediately following the symbol λ are, when taken in the order in which they occur in the formula, in alphabetical order, without repetitions, and without omissions except of variables which are free variables of the formula. For example, λab.ba, and λa.a(λc.bc), and λb.ba are in principal normal form; and λac.ca, and λbc.cb, and λa.a(λa.ba) are in normal form but not in principal normal form.

如果 B 处于主正规形，而且 A conv B，就称 B 为 A 的一个主正规形。处于正规形的公式总可以经 I 转换为相应的主正规形，因此，每个有正规形的公式也都有主正规形。下一节将证明，公式的主正规形如果存在，就是唯一的。

We shall call B a principal normal form of A if B is in principal normal form and A conv B. A formula in normal form is always convertible-I into a corresponding formula in principal normal form, and hence every formula which has a normal form has a principal normal form. We shall show in the next section that the principal normal form of a formula, if it exists, is unique.

没有正规形、因而也没有主正规形的公式的一个例子是 (λx.xxx)(λx.xxx)。

An example of a formula which has no normal form (and therefore no principal normal form) is (λx.xxx)(λx.xxx).

我们希望，在形式演算的任何解释中，只有那些具有正规形的合式公式才有意义；而在这些公式中，相互可转换的公式应当具有相同意义。因此，合式性是有意义的必要条件，但不是充分条件。

It is intended that, in any interpretation of the formal calculus, only those well-formed formulas which have a normal form shall be meaningful, and, among these, interconvertible formulas shall have the same meaning. The condition of being well-formed is thus a necessary condition for meaningfulness but not a sufficient condition.

重要的是：合式性条件在本节开头所解释的意义下是有效的，而“合式并且有正规形”这个条件不是有效的。

It is important that the condition of being well-formed is effective in the sense explained at the beginning of this section, whereas the condition of being well-formed and having a normal form is not effective.

7. 关于合式公式与正规形的基本定理

7. Fundamental Theorems on Well-Formed Formulas and on the Normal Form

下面的定理取自 Kleene [34]，只作了非本质性的改动，以适应这里修改后的记法。证明留给读者；也可以在 Kleene 的上述文献中找到证明提纲。

The following theorems are taken from Kleene [34] (with non-essential changes to adapt them to the present modified notation). Their proof is left to the reader; or an outline of the proof may be found in Kleene, loc. cit.

7 I. 在合式公式 K 中，左圆括号的各次出现与右圆括号的相应出现之间，存在唯一配对，使得 K 的任意两个由一对相应括号围成的部分，包括括号本身，要么不重叠，要么一个完全包含在另一个之内。此外，如果 K 的第 n 个至第 n+r 个符号之间的部分，包括两端符号，存在这种配对，那么它就是 K 中配对的一部分。

7 I. In a well-formed formula K there exists a unique pairing of the occurrences of the symbol (, each with a corresponding occurrence of the symbol ), in such a way that two portions of K, each lying between an occurrence of ( and the corresponding occurrence of ) inclusively, either are non-overlapping or else are contained one entirely within the other. Moreover, if such a pairing exists in the portion of K lying between the nth and the (n+r)th symbol of K inclusively, it is a part of the pairing in K.

7 II. 合式公式 K 中，由某次左圆括号出现至某次右圆括号出现之间的部分 N，包括两端括号，合式的充要条件是：这两次括号出现相互对应。

7 II. A necessary and sufficient condition that the portion N of a well-formed formula K which lies between a given occurrence of ( in K and a given occurrence of ) in K inclusively be well-formed is that the given occurrence of ( and the given occurrence of ) correspond.

7 III. 每个合式公式都具有以下三种形式之一：x，其中 x 是变量；(FA)，其中 F 和 A 合式；或 (λxM)，其中 M 合式，而且 x 是 M 的自由变量。

7 III. Every well-formed formula has one of the three forms, x, where x is a variable, or (FA), where F and A are well-formed, or (λxM), where M is well-formed and x is a free variable of M.

7 IV. 如果 (FA) 合式，而且 F 或 A 之一合式，那么 F 和 A 都合式。

7 IV. If (FA) and either F or A is well-formed, then both F and A are well-formed.

7 V. 如果 (λxM) 合式，其中 x 是变量，那么 M 合式，而且 x 是 M 的自由变量。

7 V. If (λxM) is well-formed, x being a variable, then M is well-formed and x is a free variable of M.

7 VI. 一个合式公式只能以唯一方式写成 (FA)，其中 F 或 A 合式。

7 VI. A well-formed formula can be of the form (FA), where F (or A) is well-formed, in only one way.

7 VII. 一个合式公式只能以唯一方式写成 (λxM)，其中 x 是变量。

7 VII. A well-formed formula can be of the form (λxM), where x is a variable, in only one way.

7 VIII. 如果 P 和 Q 是合式公式 K 的合式部分，那么，P 是 Q 的一部分，或者 Q 是 P 的一部分，或者 P 和 Q 不重叠。

7 VIII. If P and Q are well-formed parts of a well-formed formula K, then either P is a part of Q, or Q is a part of P, or P and Q are non-overlapping.

7 IX. 同一个合式公式 P 作为合式公式 K 的一部分的两次不同出现，必定不重叠。

7 IX. Two distinct occurrences of the same well-formed formula P as a part of a well-formed formula K must be non-overlapping.

7 X. 如果 P、F、A 合式，而且 P 是 (FA) 的一部分，那么 P 就是 (FA)，或者 P 是 F 的一部分，或者 P 是 A 的一部分。

7 X. If P,F,A are well-formed and P is a part of (FA), then P is (FA) or P is a part of F or P is a part of A.

7 XI. 如果 P 和 M 合式，x 是变量，而且 P 是 (λxM) 的一部分，那么 P 就是 (λxM)，或者 P 是 x，或者 P 是 M 的一部分。其中“P 是 x”这一项是多余的，因为我们赋予“公式的部分”这个词的意义已经排除了它，见第 6 节。

7 XI. If P and M are well-formed and x is a variable and P is a part of (λxM), then P is (λxM) [or P is x] or P is a part of M. The clause in brackets is superfluous because of the meaning we give to the word part of a formula; see §6.

7 XII. 变量 x 在合式公式 K 中的某次出现，是约束还是自由，取决于它是否位于 K 的某个形如 (λxM) 的合式部分中。因此，特别地，合式公式中变量的任何一次出现，都不会既是约束的又是自由的。

7 XII. An occurrence of a variable x in a well-formed formula K is bound or free according as it is or is not an occurrence in a well-formed part of K of the form (λxM). Hence, in particular, no occurrence of a variable in a well-formed formula is both bound and free.

7 XIII. 如果 M 合式，变量 x 不是 M 的自由变量，而且变量 y 不在 M 中出现，那么 SyxM| 合式，并且具有与 M 相同的自由变量。

7 XIII. If M is well-formed and the variable x is not a free variable of M and the variable y does not occur in M, then SyxM| is well-formed and has the same free variables as M.

7 XIV. 如果 M 和 N 合式，变量 x 在 M 中出现，而且 M 的约束变量既不同于 x，也不同于 N 的自由变量，那么 SNxM| 和 ((λxM)N) 都合式，并且具有相同的自由变量。

7 XIV. If M and N are well-formed and the variable x occurs in M and the bound variables of M are distinct both from x and from the free variables of N, then SNxM| and ((λxM)N) are well-formed and have the same free variables.

7 XV. 如果 K、P、Q 合式，而且 P 的所有自由变量也是 Q 的自由变量，那么把 K 中 P 的某次特定出现替换为 Q 后得到的公式是合式的，只要该次出现不紧接在 λ 后面。

7 XV. If K,P,Q are well-formed and all free variables of P are also free variables of Q, the formula obtained by substituting Q for a particular occurrence of P in K, not immediately following an occurrence of λ, is well-formed.

7 XVI. 如果 A 合式，而且 A conv B，那么 B 合式。

7 XVI. If A is well-formed and A conv B, then B is well-formed.

7 XVII. 如果 A 合式，而且 A conv B，那么 A 和 B 具有相同的自由变量。

7 XVII. If A is well-formed and A conv B, then A and B have the same free variables.

7 XVIII. 如果 K、P、Q 合式，P conv Q，而且 L 是把 K 中 P 的某次特定出现替换为 Q 后得到的公式，该次出现不紧接在 λ 后面，那么 K conv L。

7 XVIII. If K,P,Q are well-formed, and P conv Q, and L is obtained by substituting Q for a particular occurrence of P in K, not immediately following an occurrence of λ, then K conv L.

设 P 是合式公式 K 的合式部分。如果 P 中变量的每次自由出现，在 K 中也是该变量的自由出现，就称 P 为 P 在 K 中的一次自由出现；反之，如果 P 中某个变量的自由出现，同时是该变量在 K 中的约束出现，就称这个部分 P 为 P 在 K 中的一次约束出现。如果 P 是变量在 K 中的一次出现，而且不紧接在 λ 后面，那么这个定义与前面对变量自由出现和约束出现的定义一致。

We shall call a well-formed part P of a well-formed formula K a free occurrence of P in K if every free occurrence of a variable in P is also a free occurrence of that variable in K; in the contrary case (if some free occurrence of a variable in P is at the same time a bound occurrence of that variable in K) we shall call the part P of K a bound occurrence of P in K. If P is an occurrence of a variable in K, not immediately following an occurrence of λ, this definition is in agreement with our previous definition of free and bound occurrences of variables.

此外，我们推广第 5 节引入的记法，允许 SNPM| 表示把 M 中所有 P 都替换为 N 的结果，其中 N、P、M 是任意合式公式。根据 7 IX，这样做不会产生歧义。

Moreover we shall extend the notation introduced in §5 by allowing SNPM| to stand for the result of substituting N for P throughout M, where N,P,M are any well-formed formulas. This is possible without ambiguity, by 7 IX.

7 XIX. 合式公式 K 的合式部分 P，是 P 在 K 中的约束出现还是自由出现，取决于它是否位于 K 的某个形如 (λxM) 的合式部分中，其中 x 是 P 的自由变量。

7 XIX. A well-formed part P of a well-formed formula K is a bound or free occurrence of P in K according as it is or is not an occurrence in a well-formed part of K of the form (λxM) where x is a free variable of P.

7 XX. 如果 K、P、Q 合式，那么把 K 中 P 的某次特定自由出现替换为 Q 后得到的公式是合式的。

7 XX. If K,P,Q are well-formed, the formula obtained by substituting Q for a particular free occurrence of P in K is well-formed.

7 XXI. 如果 K、P、Q 合式，而且 K 中没有 P 的约束出现，那么 SQPK| 合式。

7 XXI. If K,P,Q are well-formed and there is no bound occurrence of P in K, then SQPK| is well-formed.

7 XXII. 设 x 是合式公式 M 的自由变量，P 是把 M 中 x 的各次自由出现替换为 N 后得到的公式。如果 P 中由此产生的 N 的各次出现都是自由出现，那么 ((λxM)N) conv P。

7 XXII. Let x be a free variable of the well-formed formula M and let P be the formula obtained by substituting N for the free occurrences of x in M. If the resulting occurrences of N in P are free, ((λxM)N) conv P.

在下面的讨论中，我们将经常默默地使用这些定理。

In what follows we shall frequently make tacit assumption of these theorems.

陈述这些定理时，必须暂时搁置“粗体大写字母代表合式公式”这一约定。今后恢复这个约定：用这种字母表示的公式，一律理解为合式的。

In stating these theorems, it has been necessary to hold in abeyance the convention that formulas represented by bold capital letters are well-formed. Hereafter this convention will be restored, and formulas so represented are to be taken always as well-formed.

现在转向取自 Church 与 Rosser [16] 的一组转换定理。为了陈述它们，必须先定义：对公式 A 依次应用规则 I 和 II 后，A 的一组部分 ((λxjMj)Nj) 的残余是什么。我们假定，如果 p≠q，那么 ((λxpMp)Np) 与 ((λxqMq)Nq) 不是 A 的同一个部分，虽然它们可能是同一个公式。这组部分不必包括 A 中所有形如 ((λyP)Q) 的部分。

We turn now to a group of theorems on conversion taken from Church and Rosser [16]. In order to state these, it is necessary first to define the notion of the residuals of a set of parts ((λxjMj)Nj) of a formula A after a sequence of applications of Rules I and II to A (§6). We assume that, if p≠q, then ((λxpMp)Np) is not the same part of A as ((λxqMq)Nq), though it may be the same formula. The parts ((λxjMj)Nj) of A need not be all the parts of A which have the form ((λyP)Q).

对 A 进行某个特定的规则 I、II 应用序列后，这些部分的残余，是 A 经该序列转换所得公式中的某些部分，它们具有形式 ((λyP)Q)。定义如下：

The residuals of the ((λxjMj)Nj) after a particular sequence of applications of Rules I and II to A are then certain parts, of the form ((λyP)Q), of the formula into which A is converted by this sequence of applications of Rules I and II. They are defined as follows:

如果所讨论的规则 I、II 应用序列是空的，那么每个部分 ((λxjMj)Nj) 都是它自身的残余。

If the sequence of applications of Rules I and II in question is vacuous, each part ((λxjMj)Nj) is its own residual.

如果序列只包含一次规则 I 的应用，每个部分 ((λxjMj)Nj) 都变为所得公式中的一个部分 ((λyjMj')Nj')，这个部分就是原部分的残余。

If the sequence consists of a single application of Rule I, each part ((λxjMj)Nj) is changed into a part ((λyjMj')Nj') of the resulting formula, and this part is the residual of ((λxjMj)Nj).

如果序列只包含一次规则 II 的应用，令 ((λxM)N) 为 A 中被收缩的部分，令 A′ 为 A 经此转换得到的公式。取这组部分中的某一个 ((λxpMp)Np)，并区分以下六种情况。

If the sequence consists of a single application of Rule II, let ((λxM)N) be the part of A which is contracted (§6), and let A′ be the resulting formula into which A is converted. Let ((λxpMp)Np) be a particular one of the ((λxjMj)Nj), and distinguish the six following cases.

情况 1：((λxpMp)Np) 与 ((λxM)N) 不重叠。在 A 归约为 A′ 的过程中，前者成为 A′ 中一个确定的部分，它仍是同一个公式。A′ 的这个部分，就是原部分的残余。

Case 1: ((λxpMp)Np) and ((λxM)N) are non-overlapping. Under the reduction of A to A′, ((λxpMp)Np) goes into a definite part of A′, which is the same formula as ((λxpMp)Np). This part of A′ is the residual of ((λxpMp)Np).

情况 2：((λxM)N) 是 Mp 的一部分。在 A 归约为 A′ 的过程中，Mp 成为 A′ 中一个确定的部分 M′p，它由收缩 Mp 中的 ((λxM)N) 得到；而 ((λxpMp)Np) 成为 A′ 的部分 ((λxpMp')Np)。这个部分就是原部分的残余。

Case 2: ((λxM)N) is a part of Mp. Under the reduction of A to A′, Mp goes into a definite part Mp' of A′, which arises from Mp by contraction of ((λxM)N), and ((λxpMp)Np) goes into the part ((λxpMp')Np) of A′. This part of A′ is the residual of ((λxpMp)Np).

情况 3：((λxM)N) 是 Np 的一部分。在 A 归约为 A′ 的过程中，Np 成为 A′ 中一个确定的部分 N′p，它由收缩 Np 中的 ((λxM)N) 得到；而 ((λxpMp)Np) 成为 A′ 的部分 ((λxpMp)Np')。这个部分就是原部分的残余。

Case 3: ((λxM)N) is a part of Np. Under the reduction of A to A′, Np goes into a definite part Np' of A′, which arises from Np by contraction of ((λxM)N), and ((λxpMp)Np) goes into the part ((λxpMp)Np') of A′. This part of A′ is the residual of ((λxpMp)Np).

情况 4：((λxM)N) 就是 ((λxpMp)Np)。这时，后者在 A′ 中没有残余。

Case 4: ((λxM)N) is ((λxpMp)Np). In this case ((λxpMp)Np) has no residual in A′.

情况 5：((λxpMp)Np) 是 M 的一部分。令 M′ 为把 M 中除该部分内的 x 以外的所有 x 都替换为 N 后的结果。在这些变化下，M 的这个部分成为 M′ 中一个确定的部分；因为它仍是同一个公式，我们仍用原记法表示它。现在，把 M′ 中这个部分替换为 SNx((λxpMp)Np)|，M′ 就变为 SNxM|。用同一替换记法指称其中由这次替换产生的那一次特定出现。那么，原部分在 A′ 中的残余，定义为：在 A′ 中，由把 A 的 ((λxM)N) 替换为 SNxM| 所产生的那次特定出现内部，刚才指定的部分。

Case 5: ((λxpMp)Np) is a part of M. Let M′ be the result of replacing all x’s of M except those occurring in ((λxpMp)Np) by N. Under these changes the part ((λxpMp)Np) of M goes into a definite part of M′ which we shall denote also by ((λxpMp)Np), since it is the same formula. If now we replace this part in M′ by SNx((λxpMp)Np)|, M′ becomes SNxM|; and we use the same substitution notation to denote the particular occurrence that resulted from this replacement. Then the residual in A′ of ((λxpMp)Np) in A is defined to be this part in the particular occurrence of SNxM| in A′ that resulted from replacing ((λxM)N) in A by SNxM|.

情况 6：((λxpMp)Np) 是 N 的一部分。把 M 中的各个 x 替换为 N 后，在 SNxM| 中产生若干次 N 的特定出现。令 ((λyiPi)Qi) 分别表示这些 N 的出现内部、与原部分对应的那些特定出现。那么，原部分在 A′ 中的残余，就是 A′ 中由把 A 的 ((λxM)N) 替换为 SNxM| 所产生的那次特定出现内部，这些 ((λyiPi)Qi) 部分。

Case 6: ((λxpMp)Np) is a part of N. Let ((λyiPi)Qi) respectively stand for the particular occurrences of the formula ((λxpMp)Np) in SNxM| which are the part ((λxpMp)Np) in each of those particular occurrences of the formula N in SNxM| that resulted from replacing the x’s of M by N. Then the residuals in A′ of ((λxpMp)Np) in A are the parts ((λyiPi)Qi) in the particular occurrence of the formula SNxM| in A′ that resulted from replacing ((λxM)N) in A by SNxM|.

最后，对于在 A 上连续应用两次或更多次规则 I、II 的序列，例如 A imc A′ imc A″ imc ……，先按刚才的方法定义 A 的这些部分在 A′ 中的残余；再把它们在 A″ 中的残余定义为 A′ 中残余的残余，依此类推。

Finally, in the case of a sequence of two or more successive applications of Rules I,II to A, say A imc A′ imc A″ imc …, we define the residuals in A′ of the parts ((λxjMj)Nj) of A in the way just described, and we define the residuals in A″ of these parts of A to be the residuals of the residuals in A′, and so on.

7 XXIII. 对 A 依次应用规则 I 和 II，把 A 转换为 B 后，A 的部分 ((λxjMj)Nj) 的残余，是 B 的一组部分，可能为空，其中每个部分都具有形式 ((λyP)Q)。

7 XXIII. After a sequence of applications of Rules I and II to A, under which A is converted into B, the residuals of the parts ((λxjMj)Nj) of A are a set (possibly vacuous) of parts of B which each have the form ((λyP)Q).

7 XXIV. 对 A 依次应用规则 I 和 II 后，A 的部分 ((λxM)N) 的残余，不可能与部分 ((λx'M')N') 的残余重合，除非这两个原部分本来就重合。

7 XXIV. After a sequence of applications of Rules I and II to A, no residual of the part ((λxM)N) of A can coincide with a residual of the part ((λx'M')N') of A unless ((λxM)N) coincides with ((λx'M')N').

设在 A₁ 上有一个归约序列 A1 imr A2 imr …… imr An+1。如果从 Ai 到 Ai+1 的归约，对于 i=1,…,n，都收缩了 A₁ 的部分 ((λxjMj)Nj) 的一个残余，就称它为在这些部分上的收缩序列。此外，如果 An+1 中已没有这些部分的残余，就说该收缩序列终止，并称 An+1 为其结果。

We say that a sequence of reductions on A1, say A1 imr A2 imr … imr An+1, is a sequence of contractions on the parts ((λxjMj)Nj) of A1 if the reduction from Ai to Ai+1 (i=1,…,n) involves a contraction of a residual of the ((λxjMj)Nj). Moreover, if no residuals of these parts occur in An+1 we say that the sequence of contractions terminates and that An+1 is the result.

有时，我们希望在这组部分可能为空时，也谈论 A 的这些部分上的收缩序列。为此约定：如果这组部分为空，收缩序列就是空归约序列。

In some cases we wish to speak of a sequence of contractions on the parts ((λxjMj)Nj) of A where the set may be vacuous. To handle this we agree that, if the set is vacuous, the sequence of contractions shall be a vacuous sequence of reductions.

7 XXV. 如果 ((λxjMj)Nj) 是 A 的一些部分，那么可以找到一个数 m，使这些部分上的任意收缩序列，都在至多 m 次收缩后终止；而且，如果 A′ 和 A″ 是两个终止收缩序列的结果，那么 A′ conv-I A″。

7 XXV. If ((λxjMj)Nj) are parts of A, then a number m can be found such that any sequence of contractions on these parts will terminate after at most m contractions, and if A′ and A″ are two results of terminating sequences of contractions on these parts, then A′ conv-I A″.

证明对 A 的长度作归纳。如果 A 的长度为 1，即 A 只由一个符号组成，结论显然成立，此时 m=0。作为归纳假设，假定命题对每个长度小于 n 的公式 A 成立。在此假设下，需要证明命题对任意给定的长度为 n 的公式 A 成立。证明分为三种情况。

This is proved by induction on the length of A. It is trivially true if the length of A is 1 (i.e., if A consists of a single symbol), the number m being then 0. As hypothesis of induction, assume that the proposition is true of every formula A of length less than n. On this hypothesis we have to prove that the proposition is true of an arbitrary given formula A of length n. This we proceed to do, by means of a proof involving three cases.

情况 1：A 具有形式 λxM。A 的所有指定部分都必定是 M 的部分。由于 M 的长度小于 n，对 M 应用归纳假设即可。

Case 1: A has the form λxM. All the parts ((λxjMj)Nj) of A must be parts of M. Since M is of length less than n, we apply the hypothesis of induction to M.

情况 2：A 具有形式 FX，而 FX 不是指定部分之一。A 的所有指定部分都必定是 F 或 X 的部分。由于 F 和 X 的长度都小于 n，应用归纳假设即可。

Case 2: A has the form FX, where FX is not one of the ((λxjMj)Nj). All these parts of A must be parts either of F or of X. Since F and X are each of length less than n, we apply the hypothesis of induction.

情况 3：A 就是 ((λxpMp)Np)，而它本身是指定部分之一。根据归纳假设，存在数 a，使 Mp 内那些指定部分上的任意收缩序列，都在至多 a 次收缩后终止；也存在数 b，使 Np 内那些指定部分上的任意收缩序列，都在至多 b 次收缩后终止。此外，从 Mp 出发，对其内部指定部分执行一个终止收缩序列，所得公式 M 在允许应用规则 I 的意义下唯一，而且含有 c≥1 次变量 xp 的自由出现。

Case 3: A is ((λxpMp)Np), where this is one of the ((λxjMj)Nj). By the hypothesis of induction, there is a number a such that any sequence of contractions on those specified parts which are parts of Mp terminates after at most a contractions, and there is a number b such that any sequence of contractions on those which are parts of Np terminates after at most b contractions; moreover, if we start with the formula Mp and perform a terminating sequence of contractions on those specified parts which are parts of Mp, the result is a formula M, which is unique to within applications of Rule I, and which contains a certain number c≥1 of free occurrences of the variable xp.

现在，对 A 的指定部分执行终止收缩序列的一种办法如下：先对 Mp 内的指定部分执行终止收缩序列，把 A 转换为 ((λxM)Np)。这时，原整个部分只有一个残余，即整个公式 ((λxM)Np)。收缩它，得到：

Now one way of performing a terminating sequence of contractions on the specified parts of A is as follows. First perform a terminating sequence of contractions on those which are parts of Mp, so converting A into ((λxM)Np). Then there is one and only one residual of ((λxpMp)Np), namely the entire formula ((λxM)Np). Perform a contraction of this, so obtaining:

SNpxM'|,

其中 M′ 与 M 至多相差若干次规则 I 的应用。这个公式中，由把 Np 代入 M′ 中的 x 而产生 c 次 Np 的出现。依次取这些出现，并对其中指定部分的残余执行终止收缩序列。

Here M′ differs from M at most by applications of Rule I. Then in this formula there are c occurrences of Np resulting from the substitution of Np for x. Take each of these occurrences of Np in order and perform a terminating sequence of contractions on the residuals of the specified parts occurring in it.

把这样得到的、对 A 的指定部分的终止收缩序列，称为特殊终止收缩序列。显然，这种序列至多包含 a+1+cb 次收缩。

Let us call such a terminating sequence of contractions on the specified parts of A a special terminating sequence of contractions on those parts. Clearly such a special terminating sequence of contractions contains at most a+1+cb contractions.

现在，考虑 A 的指定部分上的任意收缩序列 μ。A 的整个部分 ((λxpMp)Np)，在其残余被收缩之前，始终恰好有一个残余，即整个公式；在此之后不再有残余。而且，如果收缩序列继续进行，对这个残余的收缩必定在至多 a+b+1 次收缩内发生。因此，不失一般性，可以假定 μ 由以下三段组成：先对不同于整个部分的那些指定部分进行一个收缩序列 ψ，再对整个部分的残余进行一次收缩 β₀，最后对其余残余进行一个收缩序列 χ。

Consider now any sequence of contractions, μ, on the specified parts of A. The part ((λxpMp)Np) of A will have just one residual (which will always be the entire formula) up to the point that a contraction of its residual occurs, and thereafter will have no residual; moreover, if the sequence of contractions is continued, a contraction of this residual must occur within at most a+b+1 contractions. Hence we may suppose, without loss of generality, that μ consists of a sequence of contractions, ψ, on the specified parts which are different from ((λxpMp)Np), followed by a contraction β₀ of its residual, followed by a sequence of contractions, χ, on the then remaining residuals of the specified parts.

显然，ψ 可以替换为：先在 Mp 的指定部分上执行收缩序列 α₀，再在 Np 的指定部分上执行收缩序列 γ₀。这里的“替换”是说，α₀ 后接 γ₀，与 ψ 得到相同的末公式，而且对每个指定部分给出相同的残余集合。此外，这种替换不改变对 Mp 的部分残余、或 Np 的部分残余所作收缩的总次数。

Clearly, ψ can be replaced by a sequence of contractions, α₀, on the specified parts which are parts of Mp, followed by a sequence of contractions, γ₀, on those which are parts of Np, in the sense that α₀ followed by γ₀ gives the same end formula as ψ and the same set of residuals for each of the specified parts. Moreover, replacing ψ by α₀ followed by γ₀ does not change the total number of contractions of residuals of parts of Mp or of residuals of parts of Np.

接着，γ₀ 后接 β₀，可以替换为：先收缩整个部分的残余 ((λyP)Np)，记这次收缩为 β′；再对所得公式 SNpyP'| 中，由把 Np 代入 P′ 中的 y 而产生的每次 Np 出现，分别应用 γ₀。这里 P′ 与 P 至多相差若干次规则 I 的应用。由于 γ₀ 可以看作对公式 Np 的变换，这里采用如下约定：把 γ₀ 应用于某个给定公式中 Np 的某次特定出现，就得到该公式的相应归约序列。

Next, γ₀ followed by β₀ can be replaced by a contraction β′ of the residual ((λyP)Np) of ((λxpMp)Np), followed by a set of applications of γ₀ on each of those occurrences of Np in the resulting formula SNpyP'| which arose by substituting Np for y in P′. Here P′ differs from P at most by applications of Rule I. Since γ₀ may be thought of as a transformation of the formula Np, the convention will be understood which we use when we speak of the sequence of reductions of a given formula which results from applying γ₀ to a particular occurrence of Np in that formula.

这样，收缩序列 μ 就被替换为 μ′：先对 Mp 内的指定部分执行 α₀，再对整个部分的残余执行 β′，最后继续收缩当时剩余的指定部分残余。

By this means the sequence of contractions, μ, is replaced by a sequence of contractions, μ′, which consists of a sequence of contractions, α₀, on the specified parts which are parts of Mp, followed by a contraction β′ of the residual of ((λxpMp)Np), followed by further contractions on the then remaining residuals of the specified parts.

现在取 μ′ 的一段 ζ：它从 β′ 开始，直到并包括第一次对 Mp 的某个部分残余的收缩。把 ζ 所作用的公式记为 ((λyP)Np)，则可以把 ζ 看作：先把 P 中各个自由的 y 替换为不同的公式 Npk，这些公式由 Np 经过不同的、可能为空的归约序列得到；然后，在可能应用若干次规则 I 后，收缩一个形如 ((λzR)S) 的残余，它来自 Mp 中某个指定部分，例如 ((λxqMq)Nq)。

Consider now the part ζ of μ′, consisting of β′ and the contractions that follow it, up to and including the first contraction of a residual of a part of Mp. Denoting the formula on which ζ acts by ((λyP)Np), we see that ζ can be considered as the act of first replacing the free y’s of P by various formulas Npk, got from Np by various sequences of reductions (which may be vacuous), and then (possibly after some applications of Rule I) contracting a residual ((λzR)S) of one of the specified parts which are parts of Mp, say ((λxqMq)Nq).

从这个观点看，R 中没有一个自由的 z 是任何 Npk 的一部分。因此，ζ 可以替换为：先在可能应用若干次规则 I 后，收缩 P 中相应的残余，即以 ((λzR)S) 为残余的那个 ((λxqMq)Nq) 的残余；再在可能应用若干次规则 I 后，收缩整个部分的残余；最后对 Np 的部分残余执行一个收缩序列。

From this point of view, we see that none of the free z’s of R are parts of any Npk, and hence ζ can be replaced by a contraction (possibly after some applications of Rule I) of that residual in P of ((λxqMq)Nq) of which ((λzR)S) is a residual, followed by a contraction (possibly after some applications of Rule I) of the residual of ((λxpMp)Np), followed by a sequence of contractions on residuals of parts of Np.

这样修改 μ′，得到的收缩序列 μ″ 仍具有与 μ′ 相同的形式，但在整个部分的残余被收缩之后，对 Mp 的部分残余的收缩少了一次。重复这个过程，最终把 μ 替换为收缩序列 ν：先对 Mp 内的指定部分执行 α，再对整个部分的残余执行一次收缩 β，最后对 Np 内指定部分的残余执行 γ。而且，ν 的收缩次数不少于 μ，因为从 μ 得到 ν 的过程中，没有一步会减少收缩次数。α 至多包含 a 次收缩，γ 至多包含 cb 次收缩。因此，ν 以及 μ 都至多包含 a+1+cb 次收缩。

If μ′ is altered by replacing ζ in this way, the result is a sequence of contractions, μ″, having the same form as μ′, but having the property that after the contraction of the residual of ((λxpMp)Np) one less contraction of residuals of parts of Mp occurs. By repetitions of this process, μ is finally replaced by a sequence of contractions ν, which consists of a sequence of contractions, α, on the specified parts which are parts of Mp, followed by a contraction β of the residual of ((λxpMp)Np), followed by a sequence of contractions γ on residuals of the specified parts which are parts of Np. Moreover, ν contains at least as many contractions as μ, for in the process of obtaining ν from μ there is no step which can decrease the number of contractions. The sequence α contains at most a contractions, and γ contains at most cb contractions. Thus ν, and consequently μ, contains at most a+1+cb contractions.

于是已经证明，A 的指定部分上的任意收缩序列，都在至多 a+1+cb 次收缩后终止。

Thus we have proved that any sequence of contractions on the specified parts of A will terminate after at most a+1+cb contractions.

现在假定 μ 是终止收缩序列。那么，ν 要么本身就是特殊终止收缩序列，要么通过显然地调整 γ 中收缩的执行顺序，就能变成这样的序列。把归纳假设应用于 Mp 和 Np，可知特殊终止收缩序列的结果，在允许应用规则 I 的意义下唯一。因此，任意终止收缩序列 μ 的结果，在允许应用规则 I 的意义下也唯一。

Now suppose that μ is a terminating sequence of contractions. Then ν either is a special terminating sequence of contractions (see above) or can be made so by some evident changes in the order in which the contractions in γ are performed. By the hypothesis of induction, applied to Mp and Np, the result of a special terminating sequence of contractions is unique to within possible applications of Rule I. Therefore the result of any terminating sequence of contractions, μ, is unique to within possible applications of Rule I.

7 XXVI. 如果 A imr B 是通过收缩 A 的部分 ((λxM)N) 得到的，A₁ 就是 A，且 A₁ imr A₂、A₂ imr A₃、……，并且对于所有 k，Bk 是对 Ak 中 ((λxM)N) 的残余执行终止收缩序列的结果，那么：

7 XXVI. If A imr B by a contraction of the part ((λxM)N) of A, and A1 is A, and A1 imr A2, A2 imr A3, …, and, for all k, Bk is the result of a terminating sequence of contractions on the residuals in Ak of ((λxM)N), then:

（1）B₁ 就是 B。

(1) B1 is B.

（2）对于所有 k，Bk conv-I-II Bk+1。

(2) For all k, Bk conv-I-II Bk+1.

（3）即使序列 A₁、A₂、……可以无限继续，也存在一个数 um，依赖于公式 A、A 的部分 ((λxM)N) 和数 m，使得从 Bm 开始，连续出现的、不满足 Bk red Bk+1 的 Bk，至多有 um 个。

(3) Even if the sequence A1,A2,… can be continued to infinity, there is a number um, depending on the formula A, the part ((λxM)N) of A, and the number m, such that, starting with Bm, at most um consecutive Bk’s occur for which it is not true that Bk red Bk+1.

（1）显然。为证明（2），令 ((λyiPi)Qi) 为 Ak 中原部分的残余，并设 Ak 到 Ak+1 的归约收缩了 Ak 的部分 ((λzR)S) 的一个残余。那么，Bk+1 是对 Ak 中的 ((λzR)S) 及这些 ((λyiPi)Qi) 执行终止收缩序列的结果。如果 ((λzR)S) 就是这些部分之一，那么它在 Bk 中没有残余，根据 7 XXV，Bk conv-I Bk+1。否则，它在 Bk 中有一组残余，根据 7 XXV，对这些残余执行终止收缩序列就得到 Bk+1。

(1) is obvious. To prove (2), let ((λyiPi)Qi) be the residuals in Ak of ((λxM)N) and let the reduction of Ak into Ak+1 involve a contraction of (a residual of) the part ((λzR)S) of Ak. Then Bk+1 is the result of a terminating sequence of contractions on ((λzR)S) and the parts ((λyiPi)Qi) of Ak. If ((λzR)S) is one of these parts, no residuals of it occur in Bk, and Bk conv-I Bk+1 by 7 XXV. If, however, it is not one of these parts, a set of its residuals does occur in Bk and a terminating sequence of contractions on these residuals in Bk gives Bk+1 by 7 XXV.

因此，除非 Ak 到 Ak+1 的归约收缩的是原部分 ((λxM)N) 的一个残余，否则 Bk red Bk+1。但从任何特定的 Ak 开始，根据 7 XXV，这种例外只能连续发生有限次。因此（3）成立，um 定义如下：

Thus Bk red Bk+1 unless the reduction of Ak into Ak+1 involves a contraction of a residual of ((λxM)N); but if we start with any particular Ak this can be the case only a finite number of successive times by 7 XXV. Hence (3) is proved, um being defined as follows:

以所有可能方式，对 A 连续执行 m 次归约。这给出一个有限公式集，因为为此目的，不必区分仅相差规则 I 应用的公式。在每个公式中，求出对原部分残余执行终止收缩序列时，可能出现的最大归约次数。令 um 为这些数中的最大者。

Perform m successive reductions on A in all possible ways. This gives a finite set of formulas (since, for this purpose, we need not distinguish formulas differing only by applications of Rule I). In each formula find the largest number of reductions that can occur in a terminating sequence of contractions on the residuals of ((λxM)N). Then let um be the largest of these.

7 XXVII. 如果 A conv B，那么存在 A 到 B 的一次转换，其中没有任何展开出现在任何归约之前。

7 XXVII. If A conv B, there is a conversion of A into B in which no expansion precedes any reduction.

在给定的 A 到 B 的转换中，设最后一个位于某次归约之前的展开，是把 B₁ 展开为 A₁。这个展开之后，有一次或多次归约组成的序列：A₁ imr A₂，A₂ imr A₃，……，An−1 imr An，而且 An conv-I-III B。B₁ 到 A₁ 的展开的逆过程，是 A₁ 到 B₁ 的归约；令 ((λxM)N) 为这次归约中 A₁ 被收缩的部分。令 Bk，对于 k=2,3,…,n，为对 Ak 中该部分的残余执行终止收缩序列的结果。

In the given conversion of A into B, let the last expansion which precedes any reduction be an expansion of B1 into A1. This expansion is followed by a sequence of one or more reductions, say A1 imr A2, A2 imr A3, …, An-1 imr An, and An conv-I-III B. The inverse of the expansion of B1 into A1 is a reduction of A1 into B1; let ((λxM)N) be the part of A1 which is contracted in this reduction, and let Bk (k=2,3,…,n) be the result of a terminating sequence of contractions on the residuals in Ak of ((λxM)N).

根据 7 XXVI，B₁ conv-I-II B₂，B₂ conv-I-II B₃，……，Bn−1 conv-I-II Bn，Bn conv-I-III An，An conv-I-III B。这就给出 B₁ 到 B 的另一种转换，其中没有展开出现在归约之前。把给定转换中原来 B₁ 到 B 的部分替换为这种转换，就使位置不当、即出现在归约之前的展开数减少一个。重复这个过程，就得到 A 到 B 的一次转换，其中没有展开出现在归约之前。

By 7 XXVI, B1 conv-I-II B2, B2 conv-I-II B3, …, Bn-1 conv-I-II Bn, Bn conv-I-III An, An conv-I-III B. This provides an alternative conversion of B1 into B in which no expansion precedes any reduction. The given conversion of A into B may be altered by employing this alternative conversion of B1 into B instead of the one originally involved, with the result that the number of expansions which are out of place (precede reductions) in the conversion of A into B is decreased by one. Repetitions of this process lead to a conversion of A into B in which no expansion precedes reductions.

7 XXVIII. 如果 B 是 A 的一个正规形，那么 A conv-I-II B。

7 XXVIII. If B is a normal form of A, then A conv-I-II B.

这是 7 XXVII 的推论，因为处于正规形的公式不能再归约。

This is a corollary of 7 XXVII, since no reductions are possible of a formula in normal form.

7 XXIX. 如果 A 有正规形，那么在允许应用规则 I 的意义下，它的正规形是唯一的。

7 XXIX. If A has a normal form, its normal form is unique to within applications of Rule I.

因为，如果 B 和 B′ 都是 A 的正规形，那么 B′ 就是 B 的正规形。因此 B conv-I-II B′。由于正规形 B 不能归约，便有 B conv-I B′。

For if B and B′ are both normal forms of A, then B′ is a normal form of B. Hence B conv-I-II B′. Hence B conv-I B′, since no reductions are possible of the normal form B.

注意，7 XXIX 保证了 λ 转换演算的某种一致性：对于某些预期具有不同解释的公式，可以证明它们不是相互可转换的。

Note that 7 XXIX ensures a kind of consistency of the calculus of λ-conversion, in that certain formulas for which different interpretations are intended are shown not to be interconvertible.

7 XXX. 如果 A 有正规形，那么它有唯一的主正规形。

7 XXX. If A has a normal form, it has a unique principal normal form.

7 XXXI. 如果 B 是 A 的一个正规形，那么存在一个数 m，使从 A 开始的任意归约序列，都在至多 m 次归约后到达 B，允许相差若干次规则 I 的应用。

7 XXXI. If B is a normal form of A, then there is a number m such that any sequence of reductions starting from A will lead to B (to within applications of Rule I) after at most m reductions.

为了证明 7 XXXI，先对 n 作归纳，证明以下引理：

In order to prove 7 XXXI, we first prove the following lemma by induction on n:

如果 B 是 A 的正规形，而且存在从 A 到 B 的 n 次归约序列，那么存在一个数 vA,n，使从 A 开始的任意归约序列，都在至多 vA,n 次归约后到达 A 的某个正规形。

If B is a normal form of A and there is a sequence of n reductions leading from A to B, then there is a number vA,n such that any sequence of reductions starting from A will lead to a normal form of A in at most vA,n reductions.

如果 n=0，就取 vA,0=0。作为归纳假设，假定引理在 n=k 时成立。

If n=0, we take vA,0 to be 0. Assume, as hypothesis of induction, that the lemma is true when n=k.

设 A imr C，C imr C₁，C₁ imr C₂，……，Ck−1 imr B。又设 A₁ 就是 A，而且 A₁ imr A₂，A₂ imr A₃，……。根据 7 XXVI，存在一个序列 D₁ conv-I-II D₂，D₂ conv-I-II D₃，……，其中 D₁ 就是 C，使得对每个存在 Aj 的 j，都有 Aj conv-I-II Dj；而且，如果 A 到 C 的归约收缩了 ((λxM)N)，那么从 Dm 开始，连续出现的、不满足 Dj red Dj+1 的 Dj，至多有 um 个。

Suppose A imr C, C imr C1, C1 imr C2, …, Ck-1 imr B. Also, where A1 is the same as A, suppose A1 imr A2, A2 imr A3, …. By 7 XXVI there is a sequence (D1 the same as C), D1 conv-I-II D2, D2 conv-I-II D3, …, such that Aj conv-I-II Dj for all j’s for which Aj exists; and, if the reduction from A to C involves a contraction of ((λxM)N), then, starting with Dm, at most um consecutive Dj’s occur for which it is not true that Dj red Dj+1.

由于 C imr C₁，C₁ imr C₂，……这个序列经过 k 次归约到达 B，根据归纳假设，存在数 vC,k，使从 C 开始的任意归约序列，都在至多 vC,k 次归约后到达正规形并终止。因此，D₁ conv-I-II D₂，D₂ conv-I-II D₃，……这个序列中至多有 vC,k 次归约，而且它必定在至多 f(vC,k) 步后终止，其中 f 定义如下：

Since the sequence C imr C1, C1 imr C2, … leads to B in k reductions, there is, by hypothesis of induction, a number vC,k such that any sequence of reductions starting from C leads to a normal form (and thus terminates) after at most vC,k reductions. Hence there are at most vC,k reductions in the sequence D1 conv-I-II D2, D2 conv-I-II D3, …, and this sequence must terminate after at most f(vC,k) steps, f(x) being defined as follows:

f(0)=u1,f(x+1)=f(x)+M+1,

其中 M 是 u₁、u₂、……、uf(x)+1 中的最大者。当然，f(x) 不仅依赖于 x，也依赖于公式 A 及其部分 ((λxM)N)，因为 um 依赖于 A 和该部分。由于只要还有可以归约的 Aj，Dj 序列就会继续，所以至多经过 f(vC,k) 次归约，就会到达一个不能再归约的 Aj。这等价于说，该 Aj 处于正规形。

Here M is the greatest of the numbers u1,u2,…,uf(x)+1. Of course f(x) depends on the formula A and the part ((λxM)N) of A, as well as on x, because um depends on A and ((λxM)N). Since the sequence of Dj’s continues as long as there are Aj’s on which reductions can be performed, it follows that after at most f(vC,k) reductions an Aj is reached on which no reductions are possible. But this is equivalent to saying that this Aj is in normal form.

因此，把 A 归约为一个公式 C，而且从 C 经过 k 次归约能到达 A 的正规形的任意一次归约，都确定一个上界 f(vC,k)，它适用于从 A 开始的所有归约序列。由于 A 到这种公式 C 的可能归约只有有限多个，彼此仅相差规则 I 应用的归约或公式 C 不必区分，我们取 vA,k+1 为这些 f(vC,k) 中的最小者。

Thus any reduction of A to a formula C, such that there is a sequence of k reductions leading from C to a normal form of A, determines an upper bound, f(vC,k), which holds for all sequences of reductions starting from A. Since the number of possible reductions of A to such formulas C is finite (reductions, or formulas C, which differ only by applications of Rule I need not be distinguished as different), we take vA,k+1 to be the least of the numbers f(vC,k).

这就完成了引理的证明。于是由 7 XXVIII 得到 7 XXXI。

This completes the proof of the lemma. Hence 7 XXXI follows by 7 XXVIII.

7 XXXII. 如果 A 有正规形，那么 A 的每个合式部分都有正规形。

7 XXXII. If A has a normal form, every [well-formed] part of A has a normal form.

这由 7 XXXI 推出，因为对 A 的某个部分进行的任意归约序列，都对应着 A 的一个归约序列，因此必定终止。

This follows from 7 XXXI, since any sequence of reductions on a part of A implies a sequence of reductions on A and therefore must terminate.

8. 正整数函数的 λ 可定义性

8. LAMBDA-DEFINABILITY OF FUNCTIONS OF POSITIVE INTEGERS

我们定义：

and so on, each numeral (in the Arabic decimal notation) being introduced as an abbreviation for a corresponding formula of the indicated form. But where a numeral consists of more than one digit, a bar is used over it, in order to avoid confusion with other notations; thus,

11¯→λab.a(a(a(a(a(a(a(a(a(a(ab)))))))))),

而不加横线的 11 是下式的缩写：

but 11, without the bar, is an abbreviation for

与这些定义相联系，我们考虑 λ 转换演算的一种解释：把每个缩写为数字记号的公式解释为指称相应的正整数。同时，我们仍打算按照第一章的思想，把演算中具有正规形的公式解释为指称某些函数；这就意味着把正整数等同于某些函数。例如，数 2 被等同于这样一个函数：以函数 f 为变元应用它时，得到 f 与自身的乘积（这里的乘积是两个变换的乘积或合成之意）；同样，数 14 被等同于以函数 f 为变元时得到 f 的十四次幂的函数（这里的幂是变换的幂之意）。这是容许的，因为抽象数论对于正整数只要求它们构成一个递进序列；在满足这一条件的前提下，可以把整数等同于任何实体。事实上，把正整数等同于被认为在逻辑上更基本的实体，可以有许多不同的逻辑构造方式（应将这里的方法与弗雷格和罗素著作中常见的方法相比较，后者把非负整数等同于相似有限类所组成的类）。

In connection with these definitions an interpretation of the calculus of λ-conversion is contemplated under which each of the formulas abbreviated as a numeral is interpreted as denoting the corresponding positive integer. Since it is intended at the same time to retain the interpretation of the formulas of the calculus (which have a normal form) as denoting certain functions in accordance with the ideas of Chapter I, this means that the positive integers are identified with certain functions. For example, the number 2 is identified with the function which, when applied to the function f as argument, yields the product of f by itself (product in the sense of the product, or resultant, of two transformations); similarly the number 14 is identified with the function which, when applied to the function f as argument, yields the fourteenth power of f (power in the sense of power of a transformation). This is allowable on the ground that abstract number theory requires of the positive integers only that they form a progression and, subject to this condition, the integers may be identified with any entities whatever; as a matter of fact, logical constructions of the positive integers by identifying them with entities thought to be logically more fundamental are possible in many different ways (the present method should be compared with that familiar in the works of Frege and Russell, according to which the non-negative integers are identified with classes of similar finite classes).

正整数函数 F，即变元范围和值域均由正整数组成的一元函数，称为 λ 可定义的，如果存在公式 F，满足：（1）每当 m,n 为正整数、Fm=n，且 M,N 分别表示（指称）整数 m,n 时，有 FM conv N；（2）每当函数 F 对正整数变元 m 无值，且 M 表示 m 时，FM 无正规形。类似地，二元整数函数 F 称为 λ 可定义的，如果存在公式 F，满足：（1）若 l,m,n 为正整数、Flm=n，且 L,M,N 分别表示整数 l,m,n，则 FLM conv N；（2）若函数 F 对正整数变元 l,m 无值，且 L,M 分别表示 l,m，则 FLM 无正规形。任意多个变元的函数也依此定义。在上述情形下，我们也说公式 F λ 定义函数 F（使用“λ 定义”而不使用“指称”或“表示”，只是因为 F 所指称的函数，其变元范围通常还包含正整数以外的元素）。

A function F of positive integers, i.e., a function of one variable for which the range of arguments and the range of values each consist of positive integers, is said to be λ-definable if there is a formula F such that (1) whenever m and n are positive integers, and Fm = n, and M and N are the formulas which represent (denote) the integers m and n respectively, then FM conv N, and (2) whenever the function F has no value for the positive integer m as argument, and M represents m, then FM has no normal form. Similarly the function F of two integer variables is said to be λ-definable if there is a formula F such that (1) if l, m, n are positive integers, and Flm = n, and L, M, N represent the integers l, m, n respectively, then FLM conv N, and (2) if the function F has no value for the positive integers l, m as arguments, and L, M represent l, m respectively, then FLM has no normal form. And so on, for functions of any number of variables. We shall say also, under the circumstances described, that the formula F λ-defines the function F (we use the word “λ-defines” rather than “denotes” or “represents” only because the function which F denotes, in general has other elements than positive integers in its range, or ranges, of arguments).

正整数的后继函数（即函数 x+1）由公式 S λ 定义，其中：

It is left to the reader to verify this, and also to verify that addition, and multiplication, and exponentiation of positive integers are λ-defined by the formulas λmn.m+n, and λmn.m•n, and λmn.mn respectively (see definitions in §5).

这些加法、乘法和乘幂的 λ 定义出自罗瑟（见 Kleene [35]）。乘法的定义依据这样一个观察：两个正整数在变换乘积意义下的乘积，等于它们在算术意义下的乘积。乘幂的定义随之成立，因为以任意函数 f 为变元应用正整数 n 时，所得结果就是变换乘积意义下 f 的 n 次幂。

These λ-definitions of addition, multiplication, and exponentiation are due to Rosser (see Kleene [35]). The definition of multiplication depends on the observation that the product of two positive integers in the sense of the product of transformations is the same as their product in the arithmetic sense, and the definition of exponentiation then follows because, when the positive integer n is taken of any function f as argument, there results the nth power of f in the sense of the product of transformations.

10. 命题函数与克林的 𝔭 函数

10. PROPOSITIONAL FUNCTIONS, THE KLEENE 𝔭-FUNCTION

所谓命题函数，是指值为真值（即真和假）的一元或多元函数。性质是一元命题函数；关系是二元命题函数。与命题函数相联系的特征函数，是指当命题函数的值为真时（即对使其值为真的变元或变元组）取值 2、当其值为假时取值 1、其他情况下无值的函数。

By a propositional function we shall mean a function (of one or more variables) whose values are truth values, i.e., truth and falsehood. A property is a propositional function of one variable; a relation is a propositional function of two variables. The characteristic function associated with a propositional function is the function whose value is 2 when (i.e., for an argument or arguments for which) the value of the propositional function is truth, whose value is 1 when the value of the propositional function is falsehood, and which has no value otherwise.

正整数的命题函数称为 λ 可定义的，如果相联系的特征函数是 λ 可定义函数。（容易证明，特征函数定义中特定整数 2 和 1 的选择并非本质；换成任意另一对不同的正整数，λ 可定义的正整数命题函数的类仍不变。）

A propositional function of positive integers will be said to be λ-definable if the associated characteristic function is a λ-definable function. (It can readily be shown that the choice of the particular integers 2 and 1 in the definition of characteristic function is here non-essential; the class of λ-definable propositional functions of positive integers remains unaltered if any other pair of distinct positive integers is substituted.)

In particular, the relations > and = between positive integers are λ-definable, as is shown by giving λ-definitions of the associated characteristic functions:

exc→λab.min2[Sa∸b],eq→λab.4∸[excab+excba].

由此可得，可用等式和不等式表达的多种正整数性质与关系都是 λ 可定义的；等式和不等式的合取、析取与否定，可以分别利用 min、max 和 λa.Pa 来处理。

From this follows the λ-definability of a great variety of properties and relations of positive integers which are expressible by means of equations and inequalities; conjunction, disjunction, and negation of equations and inequalities can be provided for by using min, max, and λa.Pa respectively.

If R₁ and R₂ are λ-definable propositional functions each of n+1 positive integer arguments, then the propositional function R is λ-definable (1) whose value for the positive integer arguments x₁, x₂, …, xₙ is falsehood if there is a positive integer y such that R₁x₁x₂…xₙy holds and R₁x₁x₂…xₙz and R₂x₁x₂…xₙz both have the value falsehood for every positive integer z less than y, and (2) whose value for the positive integer arguments x₁, x₂, …, xₙ is truth if there is a positive integer y such that R₂x₁x₂…xₙy holds and R₁x₁x₂…xₙy has the value falsehood and R₁x₁x₂…xₙz and R₂x₁x₂…xₙz both have the value falsehood for every positive integer z less than y, and (3) which has no value otherwise.

If F and G are functions of positive integers, each being a function of one argument and including the integer 1 in its range of arguments, and if F and G λ-define F and G respectively, then alt FG λ-defines the function whose value for the odd integer 2x−1 is Fx and whose value for the even integer 2x is Gx.
