具有 𝔭 和 π 的本质性质的公式最初由克林得到。这些公式 λ 定义了正整数函数的某些函数（这里的意义无需明确给出定义也容易理解），如前面已经指出的那样。

Formulas having the essential properties of 𝔭 and π were first obtained by Kleene. These formulas λ-define (in a sense which will be readily understood without explicit definition) certain functions of functions of positive integers, as already indicated.

作为公式 𝔭 的进一步应用，我们给出通常意义下的正整数减法（即当 x≤y 时，x−y 无值）和整除（即除非 x 是 y 的倍数，否则 x÷y 无值）的 λ 定义：

As a further application of the formula 𝔭, we give λ-definitions of subtraction of positive integers in the ordinary sense (so that x−y has no value if x ≤ y) and exact division (so that x÷y has no value unless x is a multiple of y):

[M−N]→𝔭(λa.eqM[N+a])1,[M÷N]→𝔭(λa.eqM[N•a])1.

11. 递归定义

11. DEFINITION BY RECURSION

正整数的 n 元函数 F，若由下列方程通过正整数函数 G,H1,H2,…,Hm（各有相应数目的变元）来定义，就称为通过复合定义：

A function F of n positive integer arguments is said to be defined by composition in terms of the functions G and H₁, H₂, …, Hₘ of positive integers (of the indicated numbers of arguments) by the equation,

Fx1x2…xn=G(H1x1x2…xn)(H2x1x2…xn)…(Hmx1x2…xn).

（不排除 m 或 n 或二者均为 1 的情形。）

(The case is not excluded that m or n or both are 1.)

正整数的 n+1 元函数 F，若由下列一对方程通过正整数函数 G1,G2（各有相应数目的变元）来定义，就称为通过原始递归定义：

A function F of n+1 positive integer arguments is said to be defined by primitive recursion in terms of the functions G₁ and G₂ of positive integers (of the indicated numbers of arguments) by the pair of equations:

Fx1x2…xn1=G1x1x2…xn,Fx1x2…xn(y+1)=G2x1x2…xny(Fx1x2…xny).

（不排除 n=0 的情形；此时函数 G1 由给定正整数 a 代替。）

(The case is not excluded that n = 0, the function G₁ being replaced in that case by a given positive integer a.)

正整数的原始递归函数类由下述三条规则定义：一个函数是原始递归的，当且仅当它可由这些规则确定为原始递归函数：

The class of primitive recursive functions of positive integers is defined by the three following rules, a function being primitive recursive if and only if it is determined as such by these rules:

（1）对每个正整数 x 都有 Cx=1 的函数 C、正整数的后继函数，以及满足 Uinx1x2…xn=xi 的函数 Uin（其中 n 为任意正整数，i 为不大于 n 的任意正整数），都是原始递归的。

(1) The function C such that Cx = 1 for every positive integer x, the successor function of positive integers, and the functions Uᵢⁿ (where n is any positive integer and i is any positive integer not greater than n) such that Uᵢⁿx₁x₂…xₙ = xᵢ, are primitive recursive.

（2）若 n 元函数 F 通过函数 G,H1,H2,…,Hm 的复合来定义，且 G,H1,H2,…,Hm 都是原始递归的，则 F 是原始递归的。

(2) If the function F of n arguments is defined by composition in terms of the functions G and H₁, H₂, …, Hₘ and if G, H₁, H₂, …, Hₘ are primitive recursive, then F is primitive recursive.

（3）若 n+1 元函数 F 通过函数 G1,G2 的原始递归来定义，且 G1,G2 都是原始递归的，则 F 是原始递归的；或者在 n=0 的情形，若 F 通过整数 a 和函数 G2 的原始递归来定义，且 G2 是原始递归的，则 F 是原始递归的。

(3) If the function F of n+1 arguments is defined by primitive recursion in terms of the functions G₁ and G₂ and if G₁ and G₂ are primitive recursive, then F is primitive recursive; or in the case that n = 0, if F is defined by primitive recursion in terms of the integer a and the function G₂ and if G₂ is primitive recursive, then F is primitive recursive.

为了证明每个正整数的原始递归函数都是 λ 可定义的，必须证明：（1）中所列函数全都 λ 可定义；若 F 通过 G,H1,H2,…,Hm 的复合来定义，且这些函数全都 λ 可定义，则 F λ 可定义；若 F 通过 G1,G2 的原始递归来定义（或在 n=0 时通过 a,G2 来定义），且 G1,G2 λ 可定义（或在 n=0 时 G2 λ 可定义），则 F λ 可定义。这三件事中只有最后一件有些困难。

In order to show that every primitive recursive function of positive integers is λ-definable, we must show that all the functions mentioned in (1) are λ-definable; that if F is defined by composition in terms of G and H₁, H₂, …, Hₘ and G, H₁, H₂, …, Hₘ are λ-definable, then F is λ-definable; and that if F is defined by primitive recursion in terms of G₁ and G₂ (or, in the case n = 0, in terms of a and G₂) and if G₁ and G₂ are λ-definable (or, in the case n = 0, if G₂ is λ-definable), then F is λ-definable. Only the last of these three things makes any difficulty.

设 F 通过 G1,G2 的原始递归来定义，而 G1,G2 分别由公式 G1,G2 λ 定义。为了得到 λ 定义 F 的公式 F，我们使用有序三元组：

Suppose that F is defined by primitive recursion in terms of G₁ and G₂, and that G₁ and G₂ are λ-defined respectively by G₁ and G₂. Then in order to obtain a formula F which λ-defines F we employ ordered triads:

F→λx1x2⋯xny.J3(y(λz[S(J1z),C2x1x2⋯xn(J1z)(J2z),J2z])[1,C1x1x2⋯xn,1])

（其中 x1,x2,…,xn,y,z 是任意 n+2 个互不相同的变量。）当 n=0 时，简化为：

(x₁, x₂, …, xₙ, y, z being any n+2 distinct variables). In the case n = 0, this reduces to:

F→λy.J3(y(λz[S(J1z),C2(J1z)(J2z),J2z])[1,A,1])

其中 A 表示正整数 a。

where A represents the positive integer a.

（第 9 节给出的前驱函数的 λ 定义，可以看作上述定义的一个特例，其中 a 为 1，G2 为 U12。将前驱函数所用的方法推广到原始递归定义的一般情形，出自保罗·伯奈斯 1935 年 5 月 27 日的一封信；不过，信中是在 λ-K 转换演算的背景下陈述此事的，因而使用有序对而不是有序三元组。正如伯奈斯指出的，这种处理原始递归定义的方法还有一个优点：它也说明，对于每个 n，以正整数函数 G1,G2 为变元、取值为通过 G1,G2 的原始递归所定义的函数 F 的那个函数 ρ，是 λ 可定义的；它本质上就是 Hilbert [31] 的函数 ρ。）

(The λ-definition of the predecessor function given in §9 may be regarded as a special case of the foregoing in which a is 1 and G₂ is U₁². The extension of the method used for the predecessor function to the general case of definition by primitive recursion is due to Paul Bernays, in a letter of May 27th, 1935, where, however, the matter is stated within the context of the calculus of λ-K-conversion and ordered pairs are consequently used instead of ordered triads. As remarked by Bernays, this method of dealing with definition by primitive recursion has the advantage that it shows also, for each n, the λ-definability of the function ρ of functions of positive integers whose value for the arguments G₁ and G₂ is the function F defined by primitive recursion in terms of G₁ and G₂, i.e., essentially, the function ρ of Hilbert [31].)

于是得到：

Thus we have:

11 I. 每个正整数的原始递归函数都是 λ 可定义的。

11 I. Every primitive recursive function of positive integers is λ-definable.

已知原始递归函数类实质上包含所有通常使用的数值函数，参见例如 Skolem [50]、Gödel [27]、Péter [41]（其中一些作者讨论非负整数而非正整数的原始递归函数，容易看出这种差别并非本质）。特别地，与带余除法中的商和余数、最大公约数、第 x 个素数以及许多相关函数相对应的函数都是原始递归的；因此，可以利用刚才的方法得到这些函数的 λ 定义。

The class of primitive recursive functions is known to include substantially all the ordinarily used numerical functions; cf., e.g., Skolem [50], Gödel [27], Péter [41] (it is readily seen to be a non-essential difference that some of these authors deal with primitive recursive functions of non-negative integers rather than of positive integers). Primitive recursive, in particular, are functions corresponding to the quotient and remainder in division, the greatest common divisor, the xth prime number, and many related functions; λ-definitions of these functions can consequently be obtained by the method just given.

通过复合定义和通过原始递归定义这两个模式具有一个共同性质：假定用来定义 F 的那些函数的所有具体值都已知，则所给方程可以通过一系列步骤算出 F 的任意所需具体值；每一步都只是用某个具体数的符号代入某个变量的全部出现，或用某物替换已知与它相等的另一物。

The two schemata, of definition by composition and by primitive recursion, have this property in common, that, on the hypothesis that all particular values are known of the functions in terms of which F is defined, the given equations make possible the calculation of any required particular value of F by a series of steps each consisting of a substitution, either of a (symbol for a) particular number for (all occurrences of) a variable, or of one thing for another known to be equal to it.

允许具有这种性质的附加模式或更一般的模式，就能得到各种更广的递归性概念（参见 Hilbert [31]、Ackermann [1]、Péter [41,42,43,44]）。如果修改原始递归性的定义，允许用具有这种性质的任意一组方程的定义来代替（2）和（3），那么，若要求所有定义出的函数对每组相应数目的正整数变元都有值，所得函数就称为一般递归函数；若不作这一要求，则称为部分递归函数。更精确的表述可以用几种等价方式中的任一种给出，读者可参阅 Gödel [28]、Church [9]、Kleene [36,39]、Hilbert and Bernays [33]。

By allowing additional, or more general, schemata having this property, various more extensive notions of recursiveness are obtainable (cf. Hilbert [31], Ackermann [1], Péter [41,42,43,44]). If the definition of primitive recursiveness is modified by allowing, in place of (2) and (3), any definition by a set of equations having this property, the functions obtained are called general recursive, if it is required of all functions defined that they have a value for every set of the relevant number of positive integer arguments, or partial recursive if this is not required. For a more exact statement (which may be made in any one of several equivalent ways), the reader is referred to Gödel [28], Church [9], Kleene [36,39], Hilbert and Bernays [33].

利用 Kleene [36] 的结果，可以由 10 I 和 11 I 证明每个正整数的一般递归函数都是 λ 可定义的。该结果是：每个以 x1,x2,…,xn 为正整数变元的一般递归函数，都能写成 F(εy(Rx1x2…xny)) 的形式，其中 F 是正整数的原始递归函数，R 是相应特征函数为原始递归的正整数命题函数，而“εy”应读作“使得……的最小正整数 y”。（参见 Kleene [37]。）逆命题，即对每组相应数目的正整数变元都有值的每个 λ 可定义函数都是一般递归的，可用 Church [9] 或 Kleene [37] 的方法证明（证明利用 7 XXXI 这一事实：约化到正规形的过程提供了一种方法，可以明确计算已给出 λ 定义的函数的任意所需具体值；证明通过建立一组实质上描述这一计算过程的递归方程来进行）。

That every general recursive function of positive integers is λ-definable can be proved in consequence of 10 I and 11 I by using the result of Kleene [36], that every general recursive function of n positive integer arguments x₁, x₂, …, xₙ can be expressed in the form F(εy(Rx₁x₂…xₙy)), where F is a primitive recursive function of positive integers, R is a propositional function of positive integers whose associated characteristic function is primitive recursive, and “εy” is to be read “the least positive integer y such that”. (Cf. Kleene [37].) The converse proposition, that every λ-definable function of positive integers, having a value for every set of the relevant number of positive integer arguments, is general recursive, is proved by the method of Church [9] or Kleene [37] (the proof makes use of the fact that, by 7 XXXI, the process of reduction to normal form provides a method of calculating explicitly any required particular value of a function whose λ-definition is given, and proceeds by setting up a set of recursion equations which in effect describe this process of calculation).

这些证明无需重大修改即可推广到部分递归函数的情形（参见 Kleene [39]）。由此得到下列定理（此处略去证明）：

These proofs may be extended to the case of partial recursive functions without major modifications (cf. Kleene [39]). Hence are obtained the following theorems (proofs omitted here):

11 II. 每个正整数的部分递归函数都是 λ 可定义的。

11 II. Every partial recursive function of positive integers is λ-definable.

11 III. 每个正整数的 λ 可定义函数都是部分递归的。

11 III. Every λ-definable function of positive integers is partial recursive.

有效计算函数值的方法这一概念，或存在这种计算方法的函数这一概念，在数学问题中并不少见；但通常它停留在直观层面，并不尝试明确给出定义。关于 λ 可定义性或递归性的已知定理，强烈地提示我们：应把正整数的有效可计算函数这一概念，等同于 λ 可定义函数，或等价地等同于部分递归函数，从而给它一个精确定义。正如对先前只是直观或经验性观念给出形式定义的所有情形一样，这里不可能有完全的证明；但作者对于这种等同的最终性几乎没有怀疑。（关于这一建议的起源，见 Church [9]，脚注 3、18。）

The notion of a method of effective calculation of the values of a function, or the notion of a function for which such a method of calculation exists, is of not uncommon occurrence in connection with mathematical questions, but it is ordinarily left on the intuitive level, without attempt at explicit definition. The known theorems concerning λ-definability, or recursiveness, strongly suggest that the notion of an effectively calculable function of positive integers be given an exact definition by identifying it with that of a λ-definable function, or equivalently of a partial recursive function. As in all cases where a formal definition is offered of what was previously an intuitive or empirical idea, no complete proof is possible; but the writer has little doubt of the finality of the identification. (Concerning the origin of this proposal, see Church [9], footnotes 3, 18.)

一个等价定义是：把有效可计算性等同于在某个形式化逻辑系统中的可计算性，其中公设和规则具有适当的递归性性质；参见 Church [9] 第 7 节、Hilbert and Bernays [33] 附录 II。

An equivalent definition of effective calculability is to identify it with calculability within a formalized system of logic whose postulates and rules have appropriate properties of recursiveness; cf. Church [9], §7, Hilbert and Bernays [33], Supplement II.

另一个具有更直接直观吸引力的等价定义出自 Turing [55]。粗略地说，如果能够制造一台有限计算机器，计算函数的任意所需值，他就称该函数为可计算的。机器配有一条用来印出计算过程的带子（类似于人工计算者所用的纸）；对于带子的长度或计算某个具体函数值所需的时间，除了每次必须有限之外，不设任何上界。对机器性质所施加的进一步限制，或多或少显然要么并非本质，要么必然包含在有限性的要求之中。可计算性与 λ 可定义性及一般递归性的等价性（限于变元范围为全体正整数的一元函数），在 Turing [57] 中得到了证明。

Another equivalent definition, having a more immediate intuitive appeal is that of Turing [55], who calls a function computable if (roughly speaking) it is possible to make a finite calculating machine capable of computing any required value of the function. The machine is supplied with a tape on which computations are printed (the analogue of the paper used by a human calculator), and no upper limit is placed on the length of tape or on the time required for computation of a particular value of the function, except that it be finite in each case. Further restrictions imposed on the character of the machine are more or less clearly either non-essential or necessarily contained in the requirement of finiteness. The equivalence of computability to λ-definability and general recursiveness (attention being confined to functions of one argument for which the range of arguments consists of all positive integers) is proved in Turing [57].

还应提到 Post [46] 引入的有限组合过程概念。它同样等价于其他有效可计算性概念。

Mention should also be made of the notion of a finite combinatory process introduced by Post [46]. This again is equivalent to the other concepts of effective calculability.

现在可以用各种方式给出不能有效计算的函数的例子。特别地，Church [9] 证明：若以直接的方式枚举 λ 转换演算的合式公式集（可以采用立即想到的任何一种具体枚举），并令函数 F 根据这一枚举中的第 x 个公式有无正规形而分别取值 2 或 1，则 F 不是 λ 可定义的。这可以看作第 6 节末尾那个略显含糊的陈述“具有正规形这一条件不是有效的”的精确含义。

Examples of functions which are not effectively calculable can now be given in various ways. In particular, it is proved in Church [9] that if the set of well-formed formulas of the calculus of λ-conversion be enumerated in a straightforward way (any one of the particular enumerations which immediately suggest themselves may be employed), and if F is the function such that Fx is 2 or 1 according as the xth formula in this enumeration has or has not a normal form, then F is not λ-definable. This may be taken as the exact meaning of the somewhat vague statement made at the end of §6, that the condition of having a normal form is not effective.

本节许多只陈述而未证明的定理，在明确证明时都使用了公式或形式表达式的哥德尔数这一概念。在所引用的已发表论文中，这个概念的引入方法与 Gödel [27] 所用的方法非常相似。不过，对于 λ 转换演算的合式公式，也完全可以使用下一章中略有不同的方法。

In the explicit proofs of many of the theorems which have been stated without proof in this section, use is made of the notion of the Gödel number of a formula or formal expression. In the published papers referred to, this notion is introduced by a method closely similar to that employed by Gödel [27]. In the case of well-formed formulas of the calculus of λ-conversion, however, it would be equally possible to use the somewhat different method of our next chapter.

第四章　组合与哥德尔数

Chapter IV. COMBINATIONS, GÖDEL NUMBERS

12. 组合

12. COMBINATIONS

若 s 是任意合式公式集，则 s 组合的类由下列两条规则定义：一个公式是 s 组合，当且仅当它由这些规则确定为 s 组合：

If s is any set of well-formed formulas, the class of s-combinations is defined by the two following rules, a formula being an s-combination if and only if it is determined as such by these rules:

（1）集合 s 中的任意公式，以及任何单独的变量，都是 s 组合。

(1) Any formula of the set s, and any variable standing alone, is an s-combination.

（2）若 A,B 是 s 组合，则 AB 是 s 组合。

(2) If A and B are s-combinations, AB is an s-combination.

在我们关心的情形中，s 中的公式不含自由变量，且没有一个具有 AB 的形式。在这种情形下，可以区分一个 s 组合的各项：自由变量或 s 中某个公式的每次出现，都算作一项。

In the cases in which we shall be interested the formulas of s will contain no free variables and will none of them be of the form AB. In such a case it is possible to distinguish the terms of an s-combination, each occurrence of a free variable or of one of the formulas of s being a term.

若 s 为空集，则 s 组合称为变量的组合。若 s 由下述两个公式 I,J 组成，则 s 组合简称为组合：

If s is the null set, the s-combinations will be called combinations of variables. If s consists of the two formulas I, J, where

I→λa.a,J→λabcd.ab(adc),

我们将证明，每个合式公式都可转换为一个组合。这一定理取自 Rosser [47]，这里的证明取自 Church [8]；其中的思想可追溯到 Schönfinkel [49] 和 Curry [18,21]。

the s-combinations will be called simply combinations. We shall prove that every well-formed formula is convertible into a combination. This theorem is taken from Rosser [47], the present proof of it from Church [8]; the ideas involved go back to Schönfinkel [49] and Curry [18,21].

令：

Let:

T→JII.

则 T conv λab.ba，从而 TAB conv BA。

Then T conv λab.ba, and hence TAB conv BA.

若 M 是含有自由变量 x 的任意组合，我们定义与之相联系的组合 ⟦xM⟧，它不含自由变量 x，但除此之外与 M 具有相同的自由变量。这个定义按照下述规则递归给出：

If M is any combination containing x as a free variable, we define an associated combination ⟦xM⟧, which does not contain x as a free variable but otherwise contains the same free variables as M. This definition is by recursion, according to the following rules:

（1）⟦xx⟧ 是 I。

(1) ⟦xx⟧ is I.

（2）若 B 含有自由变量 x 而 A 不含，则 ⟦xAB⟧ 是 JT⟦xB⟧(JIA)。

(2) If B contains x as a free variable and A does not, ⟦xAB⟧ is JT⟦xB⟧(JIA).

（3）若 A 含有自由变量 x 而 B 不含，则 ⟦xAB⟧ 是 JTB⟦xA⟧。

(3) If A contains x as a free variable and B does not, ⟦xAB⟧ is JTB⟦xA⟧.

（4）若 A,B 都含有自由变量 x，则 ⟦xAB⟧ 是：

(4) If both A and B contain x as a free variable, ⟦xAB⟧ is

JTT(JI(JTT(JT⟦xB⟧(JT⟦xA⟧J))))

12 I. 若 M 是含有自由变量 x 的组合，则 ⟦xM⟧ conv λxM。

12 I. If M is a combination containing x as a free variable, ⟦xM⟧ conv λxM.

我们对 M 的项数作归纳证明。若 M 只有一项，则 M 就是 x，而 ⟦xx⟧ 是 I，它可转换为 λx.x。

We prove this by induction with respect to the number of terms of M. If M has one term, then M is x, and ⟦xx⟧ is I, which is convertible into λx.x.

若 M 是 AB，且 B 含有自由变量 x 而 A 不含，则 ⟦xM⟧ 是 JT⟦xB⟧(JIA)；由 I,J,T 的定义，它可转换为 λd.A(⟦xB⟧d)；由归纳假设，这可转换为 λd.A((λxB)d)，最后可转换为 λx.AB。

If M is AB and B contains x as a free variable and A does not, then ⟦xM⟧ is JT⟦xB⟧(JIA), which (see definitions of I, J, T) is convertible into λd.A(⟦xB⟧d), which, by hypothesis of induction, is convertible into λd.A((λxB)d) which finally is convertible into λx.AB.

若 M 是 AB，且 A 含有自由变量 x 而 B 不含，则 ⟦xM⟧ 是 JTB⟦xA⟧；它可转换为 λd.⟦xA⟧dB；由归纳假设，这可转换为 λd.(λxA)dB，最后可转换为 λx.AB。

If M is AB and A contains x as a free variable and B does not, then ⟦xM⟧ is JTB⟦xA⟧, which is convertible into λd.⟦xA⟧dB, which, by hypothesis of induction is convertible into λd.(λxA)dB, which finally is convertible into λx.AB.

若 M 是 AB，且 A,B 都含有自由变量 x，则 ⟦xM⟧ 由规则（4）给出；它可转换为 λd.⟦xA⟧d(⟦xB⟧d)；由归纳假设，这可转换为 λd.(λxA)d((λxB)d)，最后可转换为 λx.AB。

If M is AB and both A and B contain x as a free variable, then ⟦xM⟧ is given by rule (4), which is convertible into λd.⟦xA⟧d(⟦xB⟧d), which, by hypothesis of induction, is convertible into λd.(λxA)d((λxB)d), which finally is convertible into λx.AB.

以上默许 A,B 不含自由变量 d。不过，在相反情形下所需的修改是显然的。

The foregoing tacitly assumes that A and B do not contain d as a free variable. The modification necessary for the contrary case is, however, obvious.

这就完成了 12 I 的证明。我们递归定义属于某个合式公式的组合如下：

This completes the proof of 12 I. We define the combination belonging to a well-formed formula, by recursion as follows:

（1）属于 x 的组合是 x（其中 x 为任意变量）。

(1) The combination belonging to x is x (where x is any variable).

（2）属于 FA 的组合是 F′A′，其中 F′,A′ 分别是属于 F,A 的组合。

(2) The combination belonging to FA is F′A′, where F′ and A′ are the combinations belonging to F and A respectively.

（3）属于 λxM 的组合是 ⟦xM′⟧，其中 M′ 是属于 M 的组合。

(3) The combination belonging to λxM is ⟦xM′⟧, where M′ is the combination belonging to M.

12 II. 每个合式公式都可转换为属于它的组合。

12 II. Every well-formed formula is convertible into the combination belonging to it.

利用 12 I，对公式长度作归纳即可证明。证明直接，细节留给读者。

Using 12 I, this is proved by induction with respect to the length of the formula. The proof is straightforward and details are left to the reader.

12 III. 属于 X 的组合与属于 Y 的组合相同，当且仅当 X conv-I Y。

12 III. The combination belonging to X and the combination belonging to Y are identical if and only if X conv-I Y.

13. 公式的原始集

13. PRIMITIVE SETS OF FORMULAS

合式公式集 s 称为原始集，如果 s 中的公式不含自由变量，没有一个具有 AB 的形式，并且每个合式公式都可转换为某个 s 组合。（必要时，为与 λ-K 转换演算、λ-δ 转换演算等中的类似概念相区别，见第五章，可以说 λ 公式的原始集、λ-K 公式的原始集、λ-δ 公式的原始集，等等。）

A set s of well-formed formulas is called a primitive set, if the formulas of s contain no free variables and are none of them of the form AB, and every well-formed formula is convertible into an s-combination. (When necessary to distinguish this idea from the analogous idea in the calculus of λ-K-conversion, the calculus of λ-δ-conversion, etc., see Chapter V, we may speak of primitive sets of λ-formulas, primitive sets of λ-K-formulas, primitive sets of λ-δ-formulas, etc.)

第 12 节已证明公式 I,J 构成一个原始集。由柯里的工作启发而得到的另一个原始集，由四个公式 B,C,W,I 组成，其中：

It was proved in §12 that the formulas I, J are a primitive set. Another primitive set of formulas, suggested by the work of Curry, consists of the four formulas B, C, W, I, where:

B→λabc.a(bc),C→λabc.acb,W→λab.abb.

为证明这一点，只须把 J 表为一个 {B,C,W,I} 组合，如下：

In order to prove this it is sufficient to express J as a {B,C,W,I}-combination, as follows:

JconvB(BC(BC))(B(W(BBB))C).

还有一个原始公式集，由四个公式 B,T,D,I 组成，其中：

Still another primitive set of formulas consists of the four formulas B, T, D, I, where:

T→λab.ba,D→λa.aa.

为证明这一点，只须把 C,W 表为 {B,T,D,I} 组合，如下：

In order to prove this it is sufficient to express C and W as {B,T,D,I}-combinations, as follows:

CconvB(T(BBT))(BBT).WconvB(B(T(BD(B(TT)(B(BBB)T))))(BBT))(B(T(B(TI)(TI)))B).

如果从一个原始公式集中删去任意一个公式后，它就不再是原始集，那么这个原始集称为独立的。上述三个原始集似乎各自都是独立的。对于集合 {I,J}，J 的独立性可由下述事实推出（利用 7 XVII）：所有项均为 I 的任意组合都可转换为 I；而 I 的独立性可由下述事实推出（利用 7 XXVIII）：若 A imr B，且 B 含有一个可转换-I 为 I 的合式部分，则 A 必须也含有一个可转换-I 为 I 的合式部分。

A primitive set of formulas is said to be independent if it ceases to be a primitive set upon omission of any one of the formulas. It seems plausible that each of the three primitive sets which have been named is independent. In the case of the set {I,J}, the independence of J follows (using 7 XVII) from the fact that any combination all of whose terms are I is convertible into I; and the independence of I follows (using 7 XXVIII) from the fact that if A imr B and B contains a (well-formed) part convertible-I into I then A must contain a (well-formed) part convertible-I into I.

15. 转换的一种组合等价形式

15. A COMBINATORY EQUIVALENT OF CONVERSION

我们希望有一组作用于组合的运算，具有下列性质：它们总把组合变为组合，并在如下意义上构成转换的等价形式：组合 X 可以通过这些运算的一个序列（零次或多次）变成组合 Y，当且仅当 X conv Y。

It is desirable to have a set of operations (upon combinations) which have the property that they always change a combination into a combination and which constitute an equivalent of conversion in the sense that a combination X can be changed into a combination Y by a sequence of (0 or more of) these operations if and only if X conv Y.

Such a set of operations is the following (OI–OXXXVIII), where F,A,B,C,D are arbitrary combinations, β, γ, ω are defined as indicated below, and the sign ⊢ is used to mean that the combination which precedes ⊢ is changed by the operation into the combination which follows:

这三十八种运算具有第 6 节的运算 I、II、III 所没有的简单性特征：（1）它们是单值的，即给定被作用的组合和所施用的三十八种运算中的某一种，所得组合就唯一确定；（2）它们不涉及在任意位置替换的观念，只涉及在指定位置替换的观念。这使第 16 节中的某些展开比原本可能的情形简单得多。

These thirty-eight operations have characteristics of simplicity not possessed by the operations I, II, III of §6, namely: (1) they are one-valued, i.e., given the combination operated on and the particular one of the thirty-eight operations which is applied, the combination resulting is uniquely determined; (2) they do not involve the idea of substitution at an arbitrary place, but only that of substitution at a specified place. This has the effect of rendering some of the developments in §16 much simpler than they otherwise might be.

OI—OXXXVIII 与转换等价的证明太长，无法在这里列出。证明可见罗瑟的博士论文 [47]（参见其中 H 节）。其中许多重要思想和方法来自 Curry [17,18,20,21]；事实上，柯里已有可看作与这里所讨论的结果近似等价的结果，但差别仍然足够大，以致我们不能直接使用它们。

The proof of the equivalence of OI–OXXXVIII to conversion is too long to be included here. It may be found in Rosser’s dissertation [47] (cf. Section H therein). Many of the important ideas and methods involved derive from Curry [17,18,20,21]; in fact, Curry has results which may be thought of as constituting an approximate equivalent to the one in question here but which are nevertheless sufficiently different so that we are unable to use them directly.

16. 哥德尔数

16. GÖDEL NUMBERS

组合的哥德尔数归纳定义如下：

The Gödel number of a combination is defined by induction as follows:

（1）I 的哥德尔数为 1。

(1) The Gödel number of I is 1.

（2）J 的哥德尔数为 3。

(2) The Gödel number of J is 3.

（3）按字母顺序排列的第 n 个变量（见第 5 节）的哥德尔数为 2n+5。

(3) The Gödel number of the nth variable in alphabetical order (see §5) is 2n+5.

（4）若 m,n 分别为 A,B 的哥德尔数，则 AB 的哥德尔数为 (m+n)(m+n−1)−2n+2。

(4) If m and n are the Gödel numbers of A and B respectively, the Gödel number of AB is (m+n)(m+n−1)−2n+2.

属于某个公式的哥德尔数，定义为属于该公式的组合的哥德尔数。（注意，属于某个组合的哥德尔数，一般并不等于该组合的哥德尔数。）

The Gödel number belonging to a formula is defined to be the Gödel number of the combination belonging to the formula. (Notice that the Gödel number belonging to a combination is thus in general not the same as the Gödel number of the combination.)

请读者验证：两个组合 A,B 的哥德尔数相同，当且仅当 A,B 相同；属于两个公式 A,B 的哥德尔数相同，当且仅当 A conv-I B（参见 12 III）。（注意，按（4）给出的 AB 的哥德尔数，是有序对 [m,n] 在第 9 节末尾所述枚举中的序号的两倍。）

It is left to the reader to verify that the Gödel numbers of two combinations A and B are the same if and only if A and B are the same; and that the Gödel numbers belonging to two formulas A and B are the same if and only if A conv-I B (cf. 12 III). (Notice that the Gödel number of AB, according to (4), is twice the number of the ordered pair [m,n] in the enumeration of ordered pairs described at the end of §9.)

哥德尔数的用途源于这样一个事实：我们的形式系统不含表示公式（即符号序列）的记号。（不能把公式用作它自身的记号，因为可相互转换的公式必须指称同一事物，尽管它们并非同一个公式；而且，含有自由变量的公式不能指称任何固定事物。）属于一个公式的哥德尔数，在许多场合可以代替该公式的记号，并常常使我们能够完成一些本来可能被认为没有公式的形式记号就无法完成的事情。

The usefulness of Gödel numbers arises from the fact that our formalism contains no notations for formulas, i.e., for sequences of symbols. (It is not possible to use formulas as notations for themselves, because interconvertible formulas must denote the same thing although they are not the same formula, and because formulas containing free variables cannot denote any fixed thing.) The Gödel number belonging to a formula serves in many situations as a substitute for a notation for the formula and often enables us to accomplish things which might have been thought to be impossible without a formal notation for formulas.

公式 form 的存在便利了哥德尔数的这种使用：若 N 表示属于 A 的哥德尔数，且 A 不含自由变量，则：

This use of Gödel numbers is facilitated by the existence of a formula, form, such that, if N represents the Gödel number belonging to A, and A contains no free variables, then,

formNconvA.

为得到这个公式，先注意：若 N 表示具有多于一项的组合的哥德尔数，则 parN conv 2；若 N 表示只有一项的组合的哥德尔数，则 parN conv 1。此外，若 N 表示组合 AB 的哥德尔数，则 Z(HN) 可转换为表示 A 的哥德尔数的公式，而 Z′(HN) 可转换为表示 B 的哥德尔数的公式（见第 9 节）。我们引入缩写：

We introduce the abbreviations:

N1→Z(HN),N2→Z′(HN).

Subscripts used in this way may be iterated, so that, for instance, N₁₂₂ is an abbreviation for Z′(H(Z′(H(Z(HN))))).

By 14 III, a formula, cb, can be found which represents an enumeration of the least set of formulas which contains 1 and 3 and is closed under the operation of forming (λab.2•nr ab)XY from the formulas X,Y. But if X,Y represent the Gödel numbers of combinations A,B respectively, then (λab.2•nr ab)XY is convertible into the formula which represents the Gödel number of AB. Hence the formula, cb, enumerates the Gödel numbers of combinations containing no free variables, in the sense that every formula representing such a Gödel number is convertible into one of the formulas in the infinite sequence cb 1, cb 2, …, and every formula in this infinite sequence is convertible into a formula representing such a Gödel number.

第五章　λ-K 转换演算与 λ-δ 转换演算

Chapter V. THE CALCULI OF λ-K-CONVERSION AND λ-δ-CONVERSION

17. λ-K 转换演算

17. THE CALCULUS OF λ-K-CONVERSION

只须对第 5、6 节中的 λ 转换演算构造作一处修改，就得到 λ-K 转换演算：在合式公式的定义（第 5 节）中，从规则 3 删去“并且至少含有 x 的一次自由出现”这几个字。第 6 节中的转换规则 I、II、III 保持不变，只是“合式”须按新的意义理解。

The calculus of λ-K-conversion is obtained if a single change is made in the construction of the calculus of λ-conversion which appears in §§5,6: namely, in the definition of well-formed formula (§5) deleting the words “and contains at least one free occurrence of x” from the rule 3. The rules of conversion, I,II,III, in §6 remain unchanged, except that well-formed is understood in the new sense.

λ 转换演算与 λ-K 转换演算之间差别的一个典型例子，是在后者中可以定义常值函数：

Typical of the difference between the calculi of λ-conversion and λ-K-conversion is the possibility of defining in the latter the constancy function,

K→λa(λb.a),

以及仿照第 8 节中正整数的定义，定义整数零：

and the integer zero, by analogy with definitions of the positive integers in §8,

0→λa(λb.b).

第 7 节的许多定理在 λ-K 转换演算中也成立。但 7 III 和 7 V 必须作显然的小修改，而下列定理不再成立：7 XVII、7 XXVI 的第（3）款、7 XXXI 和 7 XXXII。可以证明下列较弱定理来代替 7 XXXI；它对某些目的已足够，特别是对 𝔭 的定义（见第 10 节）：

Many of the theorems of §7 hold also in the calculus of λ-K-conversion. But obvious minor modifications must be made in 7 III and 7 V, and the following theorems fail: 7 XVII, clause (3) of 7 XXVI, and 7 XXXI, and 7 XXXII. Instead of 7 XXXI, the following weaker theorem can be proved, which is sufficient for certain purposes, in particular for the definition of 𝔭 (see §10):

17 I. 若某次归约中规则 II 的应用，是对如下形式的公式中开头的 (λxM)N1 作收缩，就称该归约为一阶归约：

17 I. Let a reduction be called of order one if the application of Rule II involved is a contraction of the initial (λxM)N₁ in a formula of the form

(λxM)N1N2…Nn.

则若 A 具有正规形，存在数 m，使对 A 的任一归约序列中至多出现 m 次一阶归约。

Then if A has a normal form, there is a number m such that at most m reductions of order one can occur in a sequence of reductions on A.

可以仿照正整数函数的 λ 可定义性，引入非负整数函数的 λ-K 可定义性概念，于是第三章的展开便可以在 λ-K 转换演算中完全平行地进行。后继函数、加法和乘法可采用与第三章相同的定义。零的存在使许多展开得到简化；特别是，在前驱函数的定义中可以用有序对代替有序三元组，而 𝔭 的定义也可按 Turing [58] 加以简化。

A notion of λ-K-definability of functions of non-negative integers may be introduced, analogous to that of λ-definability of functions of positive integers, and the developments of Chapter III may then be completely paralleled in the calculus of λ-K-conversion. The same definitions may be employed for the successor function and for addition and multiplication as in Chapter III. Many of the developments are simplified by the presence of the zero: in particular, ordered pairs may be employed instead of ordered triads in the definition of the predecessor function, and the definition of 𝔭 may be simplified as in Turing [58].

可以证明（见 Kleene [37]、Turing [57]），单个非负整数变元的函数 F 是 λ-K 可定义的，当且仅当 λx.F(x−1)+1 是 λ 可定义的；多变元函数也有类似结果。

It can be proved (see Kleene [37], Turing [57]) that a function F of one non-negative integer argument is λ-K-definable if and only if λx.F(x−1)+1 is λ-definable, and similarly for functions of more than one argument.

λ-K 转换演算相对于 λ 转换演算有显然的优点，包括能够定义常值函数，以及以更简单、更自然的方式引入整数零。然而，对许多目的，特别是对下文第 21 节所勾勒的那种符号逻辑系统的展开，7 XXXII 的失效所造成的损失远远超过这些优点。事实上，若我们认为恰好那些具有正规形的公式才有意义，那么 FM 有正规形而 M 无正规形（这在 λ-K 转换演算中可能发生），显然就变得不合理。即使对有意义性施加更严格的条件，仍可从下述理由反对 λ-K 转换演算的规则 III：若 N 是不含自由变量的有意义公式，那么除非 M 有意义，否则不应允许用 (λxN)M 替换 N。这种说法涉及公式的意义，因而诉诸直观；但在某些方向的形式展开中，确实会出现相应的困难。

The calculus of λ-K-conversion has obvious advantages over the calculus of λ-conversion, including the possibility of defining the constancy function and of introducing the integer zero in a simpler and more natural way. However, for many purposes, in particular for the development of a system of symbolic logic such as that sketched in §21 below, these advantages are more than offset by the failure of 7 XXXII. Indeed if we regard those and only those formulas as meaningful which have a normal form, it becomes clearly unreasonable that FM should have a normal form and M have no normal form (as may happen in the calculus of λ-K-conversion); or even if we impose a more stringent condition of meaningfulness, Rule III of the calculus of λ-K-conversion can be objected to on the ground that if N is a meaningful formula containing no free variables, the substitution of (λxN)M for N ought not to be possible unless M is meaningful. This way of putting the matter involves the meanings of the formulas, and thus an appeal to intuition, but corresponding difficulties do appear in the formal developments in certain directions.

18. 受限 λ-K 转换演算

18. THE CALCULUS OF RESTRICTED λ-K-CONVERSION

为避免刚才所述的困难，Bernays [4] 提议修改 λ-K 转换演算，在规则 II、III 中加入条件，要求 M 必须处于正规形（注意，“处于正规形”这一条件是有效的，尽管“具有正规形”这一条件不是）。我们把所得演算称为受限 λ-K 转换演算。由第 7 节的方法可知，在这个演算中，一个在 λ-K 转换演算中具有正规形、且不含无正规形部分的公式，仍将具有同一个正规形；特别地，在 λ 转换演算中已有的转换到正规形的可能性没有丧失。另一方面，定理 7 XXVIII—7 XXXII 在受限 λ-K 转换演算中仍然有效，而且比在 λ 转换演算中更容易证明。（还应补充：7 XXVIII—7 XXXII 对受限 λ-K 转换演算的内容，在某种意义上比这些定理对 λ 转换演算的内容少得多；事实上，如果不加上这样的定理，即对于所有部分都有正规形的公式，它与不受限的 λ-K 转换演算等价，那么从直观观点看，这些定理还不足以确立受限 λ-K 转换演算的妥当性。）

In order to avoid the difficulty just described, Bernays [4] has proposed a modification of the calculus of λ-K-conversion which consists in adding to Rules II and III the proviso that M shall be in normal form (notice that the condition of being in normal form is effective, although that of having a normal form is not). We shall call the calculus so obtained the calculus of restricted λ-K-conversion. In it, as follows by the methods of §7, a formula which in the calculus of λ-K-conversion had a normal form and had no parts without normal form will continue to have the same normal form; in particular, no possibility of conversion into a normal form is lost which existed in the calculus of λ-conversion. On the other hand, all of the theorems 7 XXVIII–7 XXXII remain valid in the calculus of restricted λ-K-conversion, and are much more simply proved than in the calculus of λ-conversion. (It should be added that the content of the theorems 7 XXVIII–7 XXXII for the calculus of restricted λ-K-conversion is in a certain sense much less than the content of these theorems for the calculus of λ-conversion, and in fact cannot be regarded as sufficient to establish the satisfactoriness of the calculus of restricted λ-K-conversion from an intuitive viewpoint without addition of such a theorem as that asserting the equivalence to the calculus of unrestricted λ-K-conversion in the case of formulas all of whose parts have normal forms.)

受限 λ-K 转换演算的展开，可以紧密遵循 λ 转换演算的展开（如第二至四章），并作第 17 节为 λ-K 转换演算所指出的那些修改。许多定理必须补充假设，断言其中某些公式具有正规形。

The development of the calculus of restricted λ-K-conversion may follow closely that of the calculus of λ-conversion (as in Chapters II–IV), with such modifications as are indicated in §17 for the calculus of λ-K-conversion. Many of the theorems must have added hypotheses asserting that certain of the formulas involved have normal forms.

19. 超限序数

19. TRANSFINITE ORDINALS

Church 和 Kleene [15] 已把 λ 可定义性的概念推广到第二数类的序数及这些序数的函数。由此，一方面得到有效可计算性概念向第二数类的推广（参见 Church [13]、Kleene [39]、Turing [59]）；另一方面得到把某些序数理论引入下文第 21 节符号逻辑系统的方法。

Church and Kleene [15] have extended the concept of λ-definability to ordinal numbers of the second number class and functions of such ordinal numbers. There results from this on the one hand an extension of the notion of effective calculability to the second number class (cf. Church [13], Kleene [39], Turing [59]), and on the other hand a method of introducing some theory of ordinal numbers into the system of symbolic logic of §21 below.

这里不重述在 λ 转换演算中的这一展开，而是简略勾勒在受限 λ-K 转换演算中的类似展开。

Instead of reproducing here this development within the calculus of λ-conversion, we sketch briefly an analogous development within the calculus of restricted λ-K-conversion.

按照第 8 节定义背后的思想，正整数（或非负整数）是某些函数的函数，即一个函数在迭代意义下的有限次幂。如果先固定一个取超限幂所依据的极限过程，就可以让第二数类的序数以同样方式对应于一个函数的超限次幂，从而把这一思想推广到这些序数。例如，可以把序数 ω 取为这样一个函数：它以函数 f 为变元时的值是函数 g，使 gx 是序列 x,fx,f(fx),… 的极限。于是 ω+1 就是 λx.f(ωfx)，依此类推。

According to the idea underlying the definitions of §8, the positive integers (or the non-negative integers) are certain functions of functions, namely the finite powers of a function in the sense of iteration. This idea might be extended to the ordinal numbers of the second number class by allowing them to correspond in the same way to the transfinite powers of a function, provided that we first fixed upon a limiting process relative to which the transfinite powers should be taken. Thus the ordinal ω could be taken as the function whose value for a function f as argument is the function g such that gx is the limit of the sequence x, fx, f(fx), …. Then ω+1 would be λx.f(ωfx), and so on.

或者，不固定一个极限过程，而把它作为一个附加变元 a 引入。例如，把序数 ω 取为这样一个函数：以 a,f 为变元时的值是函数 g，使 gx 是序列 x,fx,f(fx),… 相对于极限过程 a 的极限。这导出受限 λ-K 转换演算中的下列定义，其中下标 o 用于把这些记号与其他场合使用的类似记号区分开：

Or, instead of fixing upon a limiting process, we may introduce the limiting process as an additional argument a (for instance taking the ordinal ω to be the function whose value for a and f as arguments is the function g such that gx is the limit of the sequence x, fx, f(fx), …, relative to the limiting process a). This leads to the following definitions in the calculus of restricted λ-K-conversion, the subscript o being used to distinguish these notations from similar notations used in other connections:

0o→λa(λb(λc.c)),1o→λabc.bc,2o→λabc.b(bc),ext{andsoon.}So→λdabc.b(dabc).Lo→λrabc.a(λd.rdabc).ωo→λabc.a(λd.dabc).

我们规定：0o 表示序数 0；若 N 表示序数 n，则 SoN 的主正规形表示序数 n+1；若 R 表示单调递增的序数无穷序列 n0,n1,n2,…，其意义是 R0o,R1o,R2o,… 分别可转换为表示 n0,n1,n2,… 的公式，则 LoR 的主正规形表示该序数无穷序列的上极限。这样，被公式表示的超限序数构成第二数类的某个初段，可以把它描述为那些能够从下方有效构造到达的序数，具体意义这里不作明确说明。

We prescribe that 0ₒ shall represent the ordinal 0; if N represents the ordinal n, the principal normal form of SₒN shall represent the ordinal n+1; if R represents the monotone increasing infinite sequence of ordinals n₀,n₁,n₂,…, in the sense that R0ₒ, R1ₒ, R2ₒ,… are convertible into formulas representing n₀,n₁,n₂,… respectively, then the principal normal form of LₒR shall represent the upper limit of this infinite sequence of ordinals. The transfinite ordinals which are represented by formulas then turn out to constitute a certain segment of the second number class, which may be described as consisting of those ordinals which can be effectively built up to from below (in a sense which we do not make explicit here).

表示第二数类中某个给定序数的公式并不唯一。例如，序数 ω 不仅由 ωo 表示，也由 LoSo 的主正规形及许多其他公式表示。因此，表示序数的公式不应被看作指称序数本身，而应看作指称某些与序数存在多对一对应的东西。

The formula representing a given ordinal of the second number class is not unique: for example, the ordinal ω is represented not only by ωₒ but also by the principal normal form of LₒSₒ, and by many other formulas. Hence the formulas representing ordinals are not to be taken as denoting ordinals but rather as denoting certain things which are in many-one correspondence with ordinals.

序数函数 F 称为由公式 F λ-K 定义，如果：（1）每当 Fm=n 且 M 表示 m 时，公式 FM 都可转换为表示 n 的公式；（2）每当序数 m 不在 F 的定义范围内且 M 表示 m 时，公式 FM 都无正规形。

A function F of ordinal numbers is said to be λ-K-defined by a formula F if (1) whenever Fm = n and M represents m, the formula FM is convertible into a formula representing n, and (2) whenever an ordinal m is not in the range of F and M represents m, the formula FM has no normal form.

上述叙述预设了经典的第二数类。通过适当修改（参见 Church [13]），可以消除这一预设，从而利用受限 λ-K 转换演算来定义一个非经典的构造性第二数类；在其中，每个经典序数若得到表示，就由无穷多个元素表示。

The foregoing account presupposes the classical second number class. By suitable modifications (cf. Church [13]), this presupposition may be eliminated, with the result that the calculus of restricted λ-K-conversion is used to obtain a definition of a non-classical constructive second number class, in which each classical ordinal is represented, if at all, by an infinity of elements.

20. λ-δ 转换演算

20. THE CALCULUS OF λ-δ-CONVERSION

λ-δ 转换演算是对第 5、6 节中的 λ 转换演算构造作如下修改而得到的：把符号 δ 加入原始符号表；它既不是非正常符号，也不是变量，而是与变量同属正常符号；在合式公式定义的规则 1 中补充规定，符号 δ 是合式公式；在第 6 节的转换规则中加入下列四条附加规则：

The calculus of λ-δ-conversion is obtained by making the following changes in the construction of the calculus of λ-conversion which appears in §§5,6: adding to the list of primitive symbols a symbol δ, which is neither an improper symbol nor a variable, but is classed with the variables as a proper symbol; adding to the rule 1 in the definition of well-formed formula that the symbol δ is a well-formed formula; and adding to the rules of conversion in §6 four additional rules, as follows:

IV. 把公式中任意部分 δMN 替换为 1，条件是 M,N 处于 δ 正规形、不含自由变量，且 N 不能转换-I 为 M。

IV. To replace any part δMN of a formula by 1, provided that M and N are in δ-normal form and contain no free variables and N is not convertible-I into M.

V. 把公式中任意部分 1 替换为 δMN，条件是 M,N 处于 δ 正规形、不含自由变量，且 N 不能转换-I 为 M。

V. To replace any part 1 of a formula by δMN, provided that M and N are in δ-normal form and contain no free variables and N is not convertible-I into M.

VI. 把公式中任意部分 δNN 替换为 2，条件是 N 处于 δ 正规形且不含自由变量。

VI. To replace any part δNN of a formula by 2, provided that N is in δ-normal form and contains no free variables.

VII. 把公式中任意部分 2 替换为 δNN，条件是 N 处于 δ 正规形且不含自由变量。

VII. To replace any part 2 of a formula by δNN, provided that N is in δ-normal form and contains no free variables.

这里，一个公式称为处于 δ 正规形，如果它不含形如 (λxP)Q 的部分，也不含形如 δRS 且 R,S 不含自由变量的部分。必须注意，“处于 δ 正规形”以及“N 不能转换-I 为 M”这两个条件都是有效的。

Here a formula is said to be in δ-normal form if it contains no part of the form (λxP)Q and contains no part of the form δRS with R and S containing no free variables. It is necessary to observe that both the condition of being in δ-normal form and the condition that N is not convertible-I into M are effective.

一个转换（或 λ-δ 转换）是规则 I—VII 的应用的有限序列。若一个 λ-δ 转换不含规则 III、V、VII 的应用，并且恰好含有一次规则 II、IV、VI 之一的应用，则称它为归约（或 λ-δ 归约）。若存在从 A 到 B 的归约，则称 A 可立即归约到 B；若存在从 A 到 B 的转换，且它由一次或多次连续归约组成，则称 A 可归约到 B。

A conversion (or a λ-δ-conversion) is a finite sequence of applications of Rules I–VII. A λ-δ-conversion is called a reduction (or a λ-δ-reduction) if it contains no application of Rules III,V,VII and exactly one application of one of the Rules II,IV,VI. A is said to be immediately reducible to B if there is a reduction of A into B, and A is said to be reducible to B if there is a conversion of A into B which consists of one or more successive reductions.

第 7 节的所有定理在 λ-δ 转换演算中也都成立，只须作适当修改（见 Church and Rosser [16]）。施用规则 I 或 II 后，(λxMp)Np 的残余与以前同样定义；施用 IV 或 VI 后，其残余定义为它变成的东西，这总是某个形如 (λxpM′p)N′p 的东西。δMpNp 在施用 I、II、IV 或 VI 后的残余，仅在 Mp,Np 处于 δ 正规形且不含自由变量时定义；其定义是它变成的东西，但在施用 IV 或 VI 且 δMpNp 本身被收缩（即替换为 1 或 2）时，它没有残余。因此，δMpNp 的残余总是形如 δM′N′，其中 M′,N′ 处于 δ 正规形且不含自由变量。对 A1 中一组部分 (λxjMj)Nj 和 δRiSi（其中 Ri,Si 处于 δ 正规形且不含自由变量）的收缩序列，仿照第 7 节的定义来定义；这种收缩的终止序列也类似定义。在 7 XXV 中，允许取收缩序列的部分集不仅包含形如 (λxjMj)Nj 的部分，也包含形如 δRiSi、且 Ri,Si 处于 δ 正规形并不含自由变量的部分。对第 7 节的证明作显然的扩展，就能证明修改后的 7 XXV，随后 7 XXVI—7 XXXII 像以前一样得出。在 7 XXVI—7 XXXII 中，必须把各处的 “conv-I-II” 替换为 “conv-I-II-IV-VI”；在 7 XXVI 中，还须考虑 A imr B 是通过收缩 A 的部分 δMN 而得到的情形。对于 7 XXX，须仿照第 6 节的主 λ 正规形定义，给出公式的主 δ 正规形定义。

All the theorems of §7 hold also in the calculus of λ-δ-conversion, if some appropriate modifications are made (see Church and Rosser [16]). The residuals of (λxMₚ)Nₚ after an application of Rule I or II are defined in the same way as before, and after an application of IV or VI they are defined as what (λxMₚ)Nₚ becomes (this is always something of the form (λxₚM′ₚ)N′ₚ). The residuals of δMₚNₚ after an application of I,II,IV, or VI are defined only in the case that Mₚ and Nₚ are in δ-normal form and contain no free variables, and are defined as what δMₚNₚ becomes, except that after an application of IV or VI in which δMₚNₚ itself is contracted (i.e., replaced by 1 or 2), δMₚNₚ has no residual. Thus residuals of δMₚNₚ are always of the form δM′N′, where M′ and N′ are in δ-normal form and contain no free variables. A sequence of contractions on a set of parts (λxⱼMⱼ)Nⱼ and δRᵢSᵢ of A₁, where Rᵢ and Sᵢ are in δ-normal form and contain no free variables, is defined by analogy with the definition in §7. Similarly a terminating sequence of such contractions. In 7 XXV, the set of parts of A on which a sequence of contractions is taken is allowed to include not only parts of the form (λxⱼMⱼ)Nⱼ but also parts of the form δRᵢSᵢ in which Rᵢ and Sᵢ are in δ-normal form and contain no free variables. The modified 7 XXV may then be proved by an obvious extension of the proof given in §7, and thereupon 7 XXVI–7 XXXII follow as before. In 7 XXVI–7 XXXII “conv-I-II” must be replaced throughout by “conv-I-II-IV-VI” and in 7 XXVI the case must also be considered that A imr B by a contraction of the part δMN of A. For 7 XXX, there must be supplied a definition of principal δ-normal form of a formula, analogous to the definition in §6 of the principal λ-normal form.

讨论 λ-δ 转换演算时，我们同时使用“λ 转换”和“λ-δ 转换”两个术语：前者指规则 I—III 的应用的有限序列，后者指规则 I—VII 的应用的有限序列。如前所述，单独的“转换”一词表示 λ-δ 转换。

In connection with the calculus of λ-δ-conversion we shall use both of the terms λ-conversion and λ-δ-conversion, the former meaning a finite sequence of applications of Rules I–III, the latter a finite sequence of applications of Rules I–VII. The term conversion will be used to mean a λ-δ-conversion, as already explained.

类似地，我们同时使用“公式的 λ 正规形”和“公式的 δ 正规形”两个术语。若一个公式处于 λ 正规形，且可由另一个公式经 λ 转换得到，就称它为后者的一个 λ 正规形。若一个公式处于 δ 正规形，且可由另一个公式经 λ-δ 转换得到，就称它为后者的一个 δ 正规形。把 7 XXIX 应用于 λ 转换演算可知，λ-δ 转换演算中一个公式的 λ 正规形，若存在，则在规则 I 的应用意义下唯一。由 λ-δ 转换演算中与 7 XXIX 对应的定理可知，一个公式的 δ 正规形，若存在，也在规则 I 的应用意义下唯一。

Similarly we shall use both of the terms λ-normal form of a formula and δ-normal form of a formula. A formula will be called a λ-normal form of another if it is in λ-normal form and can be obtained from the other by λ-conversion. A formula will be called a δ-normal form of another if it is in δ-normal form and can be obtained from the other by λ-δ-conversion. By 7 XXIX applied to the calculus of λ-conversion, the λ-normal form of a formula (in the calculus of λ-δ-conversion), if it exists, is unique to within applications of Rule I. By the analogue of 7 XXIX for the calculus of λ-δ-conversion, the δ-normal form of a formula, if it exists, is unique to within applications of Rule I.

要看出 λ-δ 转换演算要求内涵解释（参见第 2 节），只须注意：例如，虽然 1 和 λab.δab1ab 在外延上对应于同一个函数，它们却不能互换，因为 δ11 conv 2，但 δ1(λab.δab1ab) conv 1。

In order to see that the calculus of λ-δ-conversion requires an intensional interpretation (cf. §2), it is sufficient to observe that, for example, although 1 and λab.δab1ab correspond to the same function in extension, they are nevertheless not interchangeable, since δ11 conv 2 but δ1(λab.δab1ab) conv 1.

可以定义一个常值函数 κ：

A constancy function κ may be defined:

κ→λab.δbb1a.

于是，κAB conv A 当且仅当 B 具有 δ 正规形且不含自由变量。因此，κ 的转换性质弱于两种 λ-K 转换演算中公式 K 的转换性质。

Then κAB conv A, if B has a δ-normal form and contains no free variables, and in that case only (the conversion properties of κ are thus weaker than those of the formula K in either of the calculi of λ-K-conversion).

正整数函数的 λ 可定义性理论可以全部移植到 λ-δ 转换演算中，因为 λ 转换演算作为一个部分包含在 λ-δ 转换演算中。只须证明，正整数函数的 λ-δ 可定义性概念并不比 λ 可定义性概念更一般；这一点可由已知方法证明，例如 Kleene [37] 的方法。

The entire theory of λ-definability of functions of positive integers carries over into the calculus of λ-δ-conversion, since the calculus of λ-conversion is contained in that of λ-δ-conversion as a part. It only requires proof that the notion of λ-δ-definability of functions of positive integers is not more general than that of λ-definability, and this can be supplied by known methods (e.g., those of Kleene [37]).

组合理论可移植到 λ-δ 转换演算中，只须把组合重新定义为 {I,J,δ} 组合。在定义属于一个公式的组合时，须补充规定，属于 δ 的组合就是 δ。

The theory of combinations carries over into the calculus of λ-δ-conversion, provided that we redefine a combination to mean an {I,J,δ}-combination. In defining the combination belonging to a formula, it is necessary to add the provision that the combination belonging to δ is δ.

若 A1 是 λ-δ 转换演算的合式公式且不含自由变量，则可找到公式 B1，使 B1J conv A1，且 B1I conv I。因为，令 A′1 为属于 A1 的组合；但若该组合既不含 J 也不含 δ 的出现，则令 A′1 为 JIIII。令 A″1 为在 A′1 中把所有 J,δ 分别替换为 j 和 δIj(λx.x(λv.vIII))(λz.zI)δ 所得的结果。则 B1 可以取为 λjA″1。

If A₁ is a well-formed formula of the calculus of λ-δ-conversion and contains no free variables, a formula B₁ can be found such that B₁J conv A₁ and B₁I conv I. For let A′₁ be the combination belonging to A₁, unless that combination fails to contain an occurrence of either J or δ, in which case let A′₁ be JIIII. Let A″₁ be obtained from A′₁ by replacing J and δ throughout by j and δIj(λx.x(λv.vIII))(λz.zI)δ respectively. Then B₁ may be taken as λjA″₁.

因此，可以用与 λ 转换演算相同的方法，证明 λ-δ 转换演算中的 14 I 及第 14 节的其余定理。

Hence 14 I, and the remaining theorems of §14, may be proved for the calculus of λ-δ-conversion in the same way as for the calculus of λ-conversion.

为得到与第 15 节所给 λ 转换的组合等价形式类似的 λ-δ 转换的组合等价形式，须在 OI—OXXXVIII 之外加入下列四种运算。其中 F,A,B,C 为组合；A,B 属于处于 δ 正规形的公式，不含自由变量，且彼此不同；C 属于表示 A 的哥德尔数的公式：

In order to obtain a combinatory equivalent of λ-δ-conversion, analogous to the combinatory equivalent of λ-conversion given in §15, it is necessary to add to OI–OXXXVIII the following four additional operations, where F,A,B,C are combinations, and A and B belong to formulas in δ-normal form, contain no free variables, and are not the same, and C belongs to the formula which represents the Gödel number of A:

OXXXIX.F(δAB)⊢F(βI).OXL.FAB(βI)⊢FAB(δAB).OXLI.F(δAA)⊢F(ωβ).OXLII.FC(ωβ)⊢FC(δAA).

读者应验证，对 A,B,C 的这些条件虽然复杂，却是有效的（第 6 节）。

The reader should verify that the conditions on A,B,C, although complex in character, are effective (§6).

要看出在 OI—OXXXVIII 存在时，这四种运算等价于转换规则 IV—VII，必须注意 βI 和 ωβ 分别可经 λ 转换变为 1 和 2。

为把第 16 节的结果移植到 λ-δ 转换演算中，只须作一些小的修改。在组合的哥德尔数定义中须加入一条：（2a）δ 的哥德尔数为 5。在公式 form 的构造中，只须对 D 再加上条件 D5 conv λx.x12δ，从而保证 form5 conv δ。o 的构造保持不变。随后可得到具有第 16 节所述性质的 occ,e,e′,r,Λ,prim,norm 和 o1—o38，其中 norm λ 定义组合属于某个处于 λ 正规形的公式这一性质。然后也可像以前一样得到 cb,ncb,O,cnvt,nf（λ 正规形运算）及 v。公式 cb 表示包含 1、3、5，并对从公式 X,Y 形成 (λab.2•nrab)XY 的运算封闭的最小公式集的一个枚举。

Only minor modifications are necessary in §16 in order to carry over its results to the calculus of λ-δ-conversion. In the definition of the Gödel number of a combination the clause must be added: (2a) The Gödel number of δ is 5. In the construction of the formula, form, it is only necessary to impose on D the further condition that D5 conv λx.x12δ, so insuring that form 5 conv δ. The construction of o remains unchanged. The formulas occ, e, e′, r, Λ, prim, norm, and o₁–o₃₈ may then be obtained, having the properties described in §16 (norm λ-defines the property of a combination of belonging to a formula which is in λ-normal form). The formulas cb, ncb, O, cnvt, nf (the λ-normal form of), and v may then also be obtained as before. The formula cb represents an enumeration of the least set of formulas which contains 1,3,5 and is closed under the operation of forming (λab.2•nr ab)XY from the formulas X,Y.

21. 一个符号逻辑系统

21. A SYSTEM OF SYMBOLIC LOGIC

若把真值“真”和“假”分别与正整数 2 和 1 等同起来，就可以在 λ-δ 转换演算的基础上建立一个符号逻辑系统。该系统只有一个原始公式或公理，即公式 2；有七条推理规则，即 λ-δ 转换的规则 I—VII。系统的可证公式或论题，就是可由公式 2 经推理规则应用的序列推导出的公式。（事实上，推理规则 II、IV、VI 是多余的，即删去它们不会减少可证公式的类；这由 7 XXVII，确切地说由 λ-δ 转换演算中与该定理对应的定理得出。）

If we identify the truth values, truth and falsehood, with the positive integers 2 and 1 respectively, we may base a system of symbolic logic on the calculus of λ-δ-conversion. This system has one primitive formula or axiom, namely the formula 2, and seven rules of inference, namely the rules I–VII of λ-δ-conversion; the provable formulas, or theses, of the system are the formulas which can be derived from the formula 2 by sequences of applications of the rules of inference. (As a matter of fact, the rules of inference II,IV,VI are superfluous, in the sense that their omission would not decrease the class of provable formulas, as follows from 7 XXVII, or rather from the analogue of this theorem for the calculus of λ-δ-conversion.)

把真值“真”和“假”与正整数 2 和 1 等同起来，当然是人为的，但看来并不会引起实际的形式困难。如果认为这不可取，可以对系统作一个小修改来避免这种人为性：引入符号 ⊢，把原始公式写为 ⊢2 而不是 2。这样，系统的所有论题前面都加上符号 ⊢，可以把它解释为断言其后面的东西等于 2。

The identification of the truth values, truth and falsehood, with the positive integers 2 and 1 is, of course, artificial, but apparently it gives rise to no actual formal difficulty. If it be thought objectionable, the artificiality may be avoided by a minor modification in the system, which consists in introducing a symbol ⊢ and writing ⊢2, instead of 2, as the primitive formula; all the theses of the system will then be preceded by the sign ⊢, which may be interpreted as asserting that that which follows is equal to 2.

在这个符号逻辑系统中，命题演算的基本运算，即否定、合取、析取，可以用下列定义引入：

In this system of symbolic logic the fundamental operations of the propositional calculus, negation, conjunction, disjunction, may be introduced by the following definitions:

J1→λx.x(λxyz.y)J2→λx.x(λxyz.z)

由这些定义可知，A∨B 只有在 A 或 B 至少有一个是论题时才可能是论题，而且看来无论怎样适当修改定义，都不能改变这种情形。已知经典逻辑系统，例如 Whitehead 和 Russell 的《数学原理》系统，并不具有这一性质。因此，显然当前系统在一个可视为具有有穷主义性质的方向上不同于经典系统。

It follows from these definitions that A∨B cannot be a thesis unless either A or B is a thesis, and this situation apparently cannot be altered by any suitable change in the definitions. Since this property is known to fail for classical systems of logic, e.g., that of Whitehead and Russell’s Principia Mathematica, it is clear that the present system therefore differs from the classical systems in a direction which may be regarded as finitistic in character.

正整数函数当然由 λ 定义这些函数的公式在系统中表示；正整数的性质及正整数之间的关系，则由 λ 定义相应特征函数的公式表示。命题函数“是一个正整数”在系统中由公式 Π 表示，定义如下，参照第 16、20 节：

Functions of positive integers are of course represented in the system by the formulas λ-defining these functions, and properties of and relations between positive integers are represented by the formulas λ-defining the corresponding characteristic functions. The propositional function to be a positive integer is represented in the system as a formula Π, defined as follows (referring to §§16,20):

Π→λx.v(metx).

一般的相等或同一关系，在内涵意义下，由 δ 表示。

The general relation of equality or identity (in intension) is represented by δ.

可以引入存在量词 Σ：

An existential quantifier Σ may be introduced:

λx.x(λxyz.x)

其中 a 是表示属于公式 2 的哥德尔数的公式；

where a is the formula representing the Gödel number belonging to the formula 2;

Σ→λf.f(ιf).

这里 ι 表示一个一般选择算子。给定公式 F，若存在某个公式 A 使 FA conv 2，则 ιF 就是具有这一性质的公式 A 之一；反之，ιF 无正规形。因此，Σ 表示一个没有否定的存在量词：若存在公式 A 使 FA conv 2，则 ΣF conv 2；反之，ΣF 无正规形。

Here ι represents a general selection operator. Given a formula F, if there is any formula A such that FA conv 2, then ιF is one of the formulas A having this property; and in the contrary case ιF has no normal form. Consequently Σ represents an existential quantifier without a negation: ΣF conv 2 if there is a formula A such that FA conv 2, and in the contrary case ΣF has no normal form.

算子 ι 应与 Hilbert 的 ε 算子（[31] 及其他文献）比较，或更恰当地与 Hilbert 和 Bernays [33] 的 μ 算子比较。使用 ι 时应注意：系统中由 F,G 表示的命题函数等价，并不必然蕴含 ιF 与 ιG 相等。

The operator ι should be compared with Hilbert’s operator ε [31 and elsewhere], or, perhaps better, the μ-operator of Hilbert and Bernays [33]. The ι should be used with the caution that the equivalence of propositional functions represented in the system by F and G need not imply the equality of ιF and ιG.

把 ι 解释为选择算子、把 Σ 解释为存在量词，依赖于把系统中的形式可证性与真等同起来。但系统所具有的一种完备性性质为此提供了根据：一个不可证的公式，除非它可转换为一个不同于 2 的主正规形、从而可被否证，否则就必定无正规形，因而没有意义。

The interpretation of ι as a selection operator and of Σ as an existential quantifier depends on an identification of formal provability in the system with truth. But this is justified by a completeness property which the system possesses: a formula which is not provable, unless it is convertible into a principal normal form other than 2 and hence is disprovable, must have no normal form, and hence be meaningless.

为便于进一步展开该系统，或为了与更通常的记号比较，可以引入缩写：

For convenience in the further development of the system, or for the sake of comparison with more usual notations, we may introduce the abbreviations:

[ιxM]→ι(λxM).[∃xM]→Σ(λxM).

在系统中引入全称量词的问题，或者等价地，引入具有否定的存在量词的问题，超出了本书范围。由 Gödel [27] 的方法可知，任何通过定义引入的全称量词都会具有某种不完备性；实际上，这与按照哥德尔的结果，几乎任何一致且充分适用的形式逻辑系统都必须具有的不完备性性质相同，只不过在这里，它从可证性的领域转移到了量词意义的领域。

The problem of introducing universal quantifiers into the system, or, equivalently, of introducing existential quantifiers having a negation, is beyond the scope of the present treatise. It follows by the methods of Gödel [27] that any universal quantifier introduced by definition will have a certain character of incompleteness; this is in effect the same incompleteness property which, in accordance with the results of Gödel, almost any consistent and satisfactorily adequate system of formal logic must have, except that it here appears transferred from the realm of provability to the realm of meaning of the quantifiers.

刚才勾勒的符号逻辑系统的一致性，是 7 XXX 的推论，确切地说，是 λ-δ 转换演算中与该定理对应的定理的推论。因为两个不同的主正规形不可能彼此可转换，所以并非每个公式都是可证的。

The consistency of the system of symbolic logic just outlined is a corollary of 7 XXX, or rather of the analogue of this theorem for the calculus of λ-δ-conversion. For two different principal normal forms cannot be interconvertible, and hence not every formula is provable.

在这个系统中，已知集合论悖论的失效，在一些较简单的情形下，仅仅取决于那个本来会导致悖论的公式没有正规形。例如，在 Russell 悖论的情形，我们发现 (λx.¬(xx))(λx.¬(xx)) 无正规形；在 Grelling 关于异谓词的悖论，或者按我们的说法，关于异谓哥德尔数的悖论中，我们发现 (λx.¬(formxx))(met(λx.¬(formxx))) 无正规形。在更复杂、表达悖论需要全称量词的情形中，悖论的失效可能取决于上文指出的量词的不完备性性质。

(The failure in this system of the known paradoxes of set theory depends, in some of the simpler cases, merely on the fact that the formula which would otherwise lead to the paradox fails to have a normal form. Thus, in the case of Russell’s paradox, we find that (λx.¬(xx))(λx.¬(xx)) has no normal form; and in the case of Grelling’s paradox concerning heterological words, or, as we shall put it, concerning heterological Gödel numbers, we find that (λx.¬(form xx))(met(λx.¬(form xx))) has no normal form. In more complicated cases, where the expression of the paradox requires a universal quantifier, the failure may depend on the above indicated incompleteness property of the quantifier.)
